title: Non-penetrating World Models
summary: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .

AI.title_zh: 非穿透世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个新问题：防止交互式视频世界模型中的物体穿透。为了解现有模型如何处理这一问题，我们提出了 NoPeBench，一个用于评估世界模型如何响应物理障碍的基准。我们的评估表明，没有任何开源模型能够可靠地防止此类失败。然而令人惊讶的是，这些模型其实已经编码了预测此类违规所需的信息。我们发现，扩散变换器（DiTs）的隐藏状态可以预测某个候选动作是否会穿透障碍物。基于此，我们提出了 NoPeWorld，一个用于检测并防止穿透的轻量级框架。具体而言，我们在冻结的 DiT 隐藏状态之上训练一个小型预测头，以读出候选动作是否安全。随后，不安全的动作会被替换为最能保留原始意图的安全动作。尽管方法简单，NoPeWorld 在六个视频世界模型上取平均，将物理违规率从 74% 大幅降低至 16%。值得注意的是，我们的方法在开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍物上展现出零样本泛化能力。我们公开发布了代码、NoPeBench 基准和模型权重。项目页面：https://nopeworld.github.io 。

title: What Must a Model Tell a Planner? Outcome Interfaces for Risk-Aware Planning After Robot Damage
summary: When a robot is damaged, it must decide which routes it can still afford, and the amount of risk it may accept can change from one mission to the next. We argue that whether a learned model helps such a robot depends on its decision interface, that is, on what the model hands to the planner. A decision policy tells the planner what to do, whereas an outcome model, a kind of world model, predicts the consequences of each route. We study simulated Unitree Go2 quadrupeds and H1 humanoids with weakened motors, added payloads, or reduced foot friction. We compare four interfaces. The first is a decision policy, and the second is the same policy trained with fixed penalties for infeasible routes. The third is an outcome model that predicts the feasibility and travel time of each route. The fourth, which we call a capability contract, is an outcome model that predicts the chance of success and the travel time of the robot on each terrain and composes them along a route. All share the same collected experience, matched tuning and risk calibration, and an uncertainty guard. Two comparatively low-risk probes let the capability contract rank hazardous terrains about as well as four new trials on every hazard. At a calibrated 5% limit on selecting empirically infeasible routes, outcome models cut declined missions from about 32% to 7-8% on Go2 and from 57% to 35-36% on H1 compared with the plain policy. Fixed penalties narrow this gap, but the best penalty changes with the risk target. Predicting outcomes lets the planner preserve missions by changing routes as risk requirements tighten.

AI.title_zh: 模型必须告诉规划器什么？机器人损伤后风险感知规划的结果接口
AI.abstract_zh: 当机器人受损时，它必须决定自己还能承担哪些路线，而其可接受的风险程度可能因任务而异。我们认为，学习到的模型能否帮助这样的机器人取决于其决策接口，也就是模型交给规划器的东西。决策策略告诉规划器该做什么，而结果模型（一种世界模型）则预测每条路线的后果。我们研究了模拟的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人和 H1 人形机器人，其电机被削弱、增加了有效载荷或足部摩擦降低。我们比较了四种接口。第一种是决策策略，第二种是用固定惩罚针对不可行路线训练的同一策略。第三种是结果模型，预测每条路线的可行性和行驶时间。第四种我们称之为能力契约（capability contract），它是一种结果模型，预测机器人在每种地形上的成功概率和行驶时间，并沿路线将它们组合起来。所有方法共享相同的采集经验、匹配的调优与风险校准，以及一个不确定性防护。两个相对低风险的探测使能力契约对危险地形的排序能力，在每种危险上都与四次新试验大致相当。在将选择经验上不可行路线的比例校准到 5% 的限制下，与普通策略相比，结果模型使被拒绝的任务从约 32% 降至 7-8%（Go2），从 57% 降至 35-36%（H1）。固定惩罚缩小了这一差距，但最佳惩罚随风险目标而变化。预测结果使规划器能够随着风险要求的收紧而改变路线，从而保住任务。

title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. To this end, we introduce StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular VLM for metric 3D spatial reasoning. StereoVLM follows a hierarchical learning paradigm spanning from cross-view correspondence and disparity estimation to calibration-conditioned metric depth perception and semantic spatial reasoning. We further find that disparity supervision generalizes substantially better than direct binocular depth supervision on unseen environments. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Stereo3D-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark across three levels, from point-level geometry to object-level spatial reasoning. StereoVLM-8B achieves 95.17% depth accuracy ($δ_1$) and a 66.98 average object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench. Intervention results further indicate that the model's performance on Stereo3D-Bench benefits from valid cross-view geometry and cannot be explained solely by additional visual tokens or semantic priors. Hierarchical geometric supervision also yields average gains of 3.54 points across five spatial benchmarks and 4.3 percentage points in RoboCasa manipulation success.

AI.title_zh: StereoVLM：用于度量三维空间推理的双目视觉-语言模型
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）展现出强大的语义理解能力，但在对物理世界中的度量三维空间进行推理方面仍然存在局限。现有 VLM 通常从一幅或多幅图像推断三维场景结构，而缺乏已知的相机标定或跨视角几何约束。这使得度量三维推断本质上具有歧义性，并且无法确定其空间预测是基于视觉证据，还是主要由语义先验所驱动。相比之下，经过标定的双目视觉提供了显式的跨视角几何，从而消除这一歧义，并为度量三维感知与几何泛化提供更可靠的基础。我们研究 VLM 如何能够直接从经过标定的双目观测中学习可迁移的三维表征。为此，我们提出 StereoVLM，这是首个用于度量三维空间推理的几何感知双目 VLM。StereoVLM 遵循一种分层学习范式，涵盖从跨视角对应与视差估计，到以标定为条件的度量深度感知以及语义空间推理。我们进一步发现，在未见过的环境中，视差监督的泛化能力显著优于直接的双眼深度监督。为评估这些能力，我们提出 Stereo3D-Bench，这是一个涵盖三个层次的综合基准，从点级几何到物体级空间推理。StereoVLM-8B 在 Stereo3D-Bench 上取得 95.17% 的深度准确率（$δ_1$）以及 66.98 的物体级平均得分。干预结果进一步表明，该模型在 Stereo3D-Bench 上的性能受益于有效的跨视角几何，且不能仅用额外的视觉 token 或语义先验来解释。分层几何监督还在五个空间基准上带来平均 3.54 分的提升，并使 RoboCasa 操作成功率提升 4.3 个百分点。

title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Comparing Categorical and Continuous World Models
summary: Visual world models can now generate compelling interactive worlds, but visual realism does not guarantee faithful dynamics. We systematically compare how categorical and continuous prediction shape learned dynamics under both next-token and iterative whole-frame generation. These choices are often bundled in approaches such as autoregressive token models and whole-frame flow matching. We design controlled 2D and 3D environments and evaluate dynamics validity, calibration, and visual quality. In 2D with lossless visual encoding, categorical models achieve higher rollout validity with less training compute, particularly for stochastic entities. Among categorical models, greedy decoding produces the highest rollout validity, while sampling from a next-token model yields the best-calibrated stochastic predictions. Failures in continuous models, such as disappearing game characters, echo those seen in more complex environments. Here, known dynamics let us measure their impact. In 3D, categorical models also achieve stronger long-horizon performance with less training compute. Even models with lossy tokenization remain competitive on semantic accuracy and FVD, despite lower next-frame RGB accuracy. Together, these findings make a strong case for categorical prediction as a compute-efficient route to learning world dynamics.

AI.title_zh: 超越视觉保真度：比较类别式与连续式世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉世界模型如今能够生成引人入胜的交互式世界，但视觉真实感并不能保证动力学（dynamics）的忠实性。我们系统地比较了在下一词元（next-token）生成与迭代式整帧生成两种范式下，类别式预测与连续式预测如何塑造所学到的动力学。这些选择往往被捆绑在自回归词元模型与整帧流匹配（whole-frame flow matching）等方法之中。我们设计了受控的 2D 与 3D 环境，并评估动力学有效性、校准性与视觉质量。在具有无损视觉编码的 2D 环境中，类别式模型以更少的训练计算量取得了更高的推演（rollout）有效性，对于随机实体尤为如此。在类别式模型中，贪心解码产生了最高的推演有效性，而从下一词元模型中进行采样则得到了校准最佳的随机预测。连续式模型的失败情形，例如游戏角色消失，与在更复杂环境中所见到的情况相呼应；在这里，已知的动力学使我们能够测量其影响。在 3D 中，类别式模型同样以更少的训练计算量取得了更强的长时程性能。即使是带有有损词元化的模型，尽管其下一帧 RGB 准确率较低，在语义准确率与 FVD 上仍具有竞争力。综合来看，这些发现有力地支持了将类别式预测作为学习世界动力学的一条计算高效路径。

title: ENC-QA: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Electronic Navigational Charts
summary: Nautical charts encode safety-critical maritime information through standardized symbols, attributes, text, and heterogeneous geometries. Interpreting these charts and assessing the navigational significance of successive chart updates requires recognizing nautical features, determining their spatial relationships, and applying navigational knowledge. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to nautical-chart interpretation, yet systematic evaluation of their fine-grained nautical feature recognition, chart-based spatial reasoning, and application of navigational knowledge to assessing chart changes remains limited. We introduce ENC-QA, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 77,312 questions derived from 6,612 National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Electronic Navigational Charts (ENCs). The benchmark evaluates four complementary capabilities: ENC Perception, Spatial Reasoning, Joint Perception and Spatial Reasoning, and Application. Of these, 8,227 questions form a progressive subset that decomposes selected chart-change cases into linked questions progressing from change detection to criticality assessment, enabling case-level analysis of how models use perceptual and spatial evidence to determine the navigational significance of chart changes. Evaluations of 10 open-weight VLMs reveal substantial limitations in fine-grained nautical feature recognition and feature-grounded spatial reasoning. Controlled evidence interventions show that relevant perceptual and spatial information improves change-criticality accuracy. Our findings establish ENC-QA as a diagnostic resource for nautical-chart understanding and safety-critical navigational decisions. We will release the benchmark and evaluation code upon publication.

AI.title_zh: ENC-QA：面向电子航海图视觉语言模型的诊断基准
AI.abstract_zh: 航海图通过标准化符号、属性、文本和异构几何图形编码安全攸关的海事信息。解读这些航海图并评估连续航海图更新的航行意义，需要识别航海要素、确定其空间关系并应用航行知识。视觉语言模型（VLM）为航海图解读提供了一种有前景的途径，然而对其细粒度航海要素识别、基于航海图的空间推理以及将航行知识应用于航海图变化评估的系统性评测仍然有限。我们提出 ENC-QA，一个诊断基准，包含由 6,612 幅美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）电子航海图（ENC）导出的 77,312 个问题。该基准评估四项互补能力：ENC 感知、空间推理、联合感知与空间推理，以及应用。其中，8,227 个问题构成一个递进子集，将选定的航海图变化案例分解为从变化检测到关键性评估递进关联的问题，从而支持在案例层面分析模型如何利用感知与空间证据判定航海图变化的航行意义。对 10 个开放权重 VLM 的评测显示，其在细粒度航海要素识别和以要素为根据的空间推理方面存在显著局限。受控证据干预表明，相关的感知与空间信息可提升变化关键性判断的准确率。我们的研究结果确立了 ENC-QA 作为航海图理解与安全攸关航行决策的诊断资源。我们将在论文发表后发布该基准与评测代码。

title: Refrain: Learning Multi-Shot Consistency from Inconsistent References for A$^2$O Video Generation
summary: A comic-book character, a photorealistic cityscape, an oil-painted coffee cup -- such stylistically diverse references provide visual guidance across shots and frames, yet generating a coherent multi-shot video that unifies their visual styles while preserving subject identities and scene content remains challenging. Existing methods maintain cross-shot continuity through additional attention control or memory processing. However, they struggle to resolve disparate per-shot styles or handle reference-target duration mismatches within a single framework. We introduce Refrain, a unified model that learns cross-shot consistency through a self-supervised reconstruction task. Reference clips from the same original video are deliberately perturbed with distinct visual edits, and the model recovers the unedited source footage under a shared style prompt. The resulting pipeline yields DurMix-300K, which pairs independently edited references of varying durations with their original videos. Operating on the A$^2$O principle (Any Reference, Any Duration, One Timeline), Refrain maps image and video references onto a shared temporal canvas without auxiliary conditioning modules. For evaluation, experiments show that standard CLIP or DINO metrics frequently overlook stylistic clashes or misinterpret intended narrative cuts as inconsistency. We propose Shot-Debiased Consistency (SDC), which uses an extensive real-video bank to establish a baseline for style variation associated with content changes within shots. By discounting this baseline divergence, SDC evaluates cross-shot style shifts against real-world distributions, where smaller residual differences indicate higher stylistic continuity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Refrain achieves state-of-the-art performance in cross-shot consistency, while excelling at shot timing, reference adherence, and text alignment.

AI.title_zh: Refrain：从不一致的参考中学习多镜头一致性，用于A$^2$O视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 一个漫画风格的角色、一幅照片级写实的城市景观、一只油画风格的咖啡杯——这些风格多样的参考为跨镜头和跨帧提供视觉引导，然而生成一段连贯的多镜头视频，在统一其视觉风格的同时保持主体身份和场景内容，仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通过额外的注意力控制或记忆处理来维持跨镜头连续性。然而，它们难以在单一框架内解决各镜头风格差异，或处理参考与目标时长不匹配的问题。我们提出Refrain，一个通过自监督重建任务学习跨镜头一致性的统一模型。来自同一原始视频的参考片段被刻意施加不同的视觉编辑扰动，模型在共享风格提示下恢复未编辑的源素材。由此得到的流程产出了DurMix-300K，它将时长各异的独立编辑参考与其原始视频配对。Refrain基于A$^2$O原则（任意参考、任意时长、单一时间线）运行，将图像和视频参考映射到共享的时间画布上，而无需辅助条件模块。在评估方面，实验表明标准的CLIP或DINO指标常常忽略风格冲突，或将有意为之的叙事剪辑误判为不一致。我们提出镜头去偏一致性（Shot-Debiased Consistency，SDC），它利用一个大规模真实视频库来建立与镜头内内容变化相关的风格变化基线。通过折减这一基线差异，SDC依据真实世界分布来评估跨镜头风格偏移，其中较小的残差差异表明更高的风格连续性。大量实验表明，Refrain在跨镜头一致性方面达到最先进性能，同时在镜头时序、参考遵循度和文本对齐方面表现出色。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Synthesize Executable Game-Playing Programs?
comment: 21 pages (main paper with appendix), 3 figures, 13 tables
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have endowed multimodal agents with increasingly strong visual perception and long-horizon reasoning capabilities, making VLM-based autonomous game playing feasible. Existing game benchmarks primarily evaluate whether an agent can select appropriate actions from the current visual state across different scenarios and games. However, most of them adopt a step-by-step interaction paradigm where the current visual observation is sent to the agent before each action. In practical deployment, this paradigm introduces two fundamental limitations: the game loop must wait for model inference, making real-time interaction impractical, and repeated VLM calls incur substantial cost. Therefore, we propose PlayScriptBench, a script-based game benchmark that evaluates whether VLMs can synthesize an executable game-playing program from game states. This setting jointly evaluates visual grounding, understanding of game dynamics, long-horizon strategic reasoning, and executable program synthesis, providing a more comprehensive assessment of game-playing agents. To support more tractable evaluation for current general-purpose VLMs, we further introduce a four-stage pipeline --- Explore, Perception, API Construction, and Strategy Composition --- that decomposes controller synthesis into game exploration, state perception, interface construction, and strategic control, enabling agents to progressively construct an executable program. Experiments on 16 games spanning 4 genres show that even strong VLMs struggle on our benchmark, revealing a substantial gap between passive visual game understanding and executable closed-loop game control. These results establish script-based controller synthesis as a complementary direction for benchmarking VLM-based game-playing agents.

AI.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型能否合成可执行的游戏程序？
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的最新进展使多模态智能体具备了日益强大的视觉感知与长程推理能力，从而使基于 VLM 的自主游戏游玩（game playing）成为可能。现有的游戏基准主要评估智能体能否在不同场景和游戏中根据当前视觉状态选择恰当的动作。然而，其中大多数采用逐步交互范式，即在每次动作之前将当前视觉观察发送给智能体。在实际部署中，这一范式带来两个根本性局限：游戏循环必须等待模型推理，使得实时交互不可行；并且反复调用 VLM 会产生可观的开销。因此，我们提出 PlayScriptBench，一个基于脚本的游戏基准，用于评估 VLM 能否根据游戏状态合成可执行的游戏程序。该设定联合评估视觉定位、对游戏动态的理解、长程策略推理以及可执行程序合成，从而对游戏智能体提供更全面的评估。为支持对当前通用 VLM 进行更可行的评估，我们进一步引入一个四阶段流程——探索（Explore）、感知（Perception）、API 构建（API Construction）与策略组合（Strategy Composition）——将控制器合成分解为游戏探索、状态感知、接口构建与策略控制，使智能体能够逐步构建可执行程序。在涵盖 4 个类型的 16 款游戏上的实验表明，即便是强大的 VLM 在我们的基准上也表现不佳，揭示出被动的视觉游戏理解与可执行的闭环游戏控制之间存在显著差距。这些结果确立了基于脚本的控制器合成作为评估基于 VLM 的游戏智能体的一个互补方向。

title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.

AI.title_zh: Embodied-Harness：迈向机器人操作中的递归自我改进
AI.abstract_zh: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体为机器人操作提供了一条有前景的途径，但仍受限于记忆组织不完善、失败归因不确定以及执行经验复用有限。我们提出 Embodied-Harness，这是一个双智能体框架，通过改进执行 harness（执行支架）而在不更新模型参数的情况下提升操作能力。Actor（执行者）通过机器人控制接口与环境交互，而 Reflector（反思者）将执行证据转化为可复用的操作指导。分层记忆架构（Hierarchical Memory Architecture）维护短期执行上下文与长期经验知识，以支持执行与反思。基于证据的经验反思（Evidence-based Experience Reflection）将失败诊断建立于所观察到的交互之上，而递归 harness 自我改进（Recursive Harness Self-Improvement）则在相继的尝试中改进操作指导。在 RoboTwin 2.0、RoboSPA 和 RMBench 上的实验表明，Embodied-Harness 在环境变化下的泛化、空间推理、长时程规划以及依赖记忆的操作方面具有有效性。我们的方法在三个基准上分别达到了 82.4%、76.7% 和 94.4% 的成功率。真实世界评估进一步在三个操作任务上取得了 96.7% 的平均成功率。这些结果凸显了 Embodied-Harness 通过经验驱动的 harness 自我改进来提升机器人操作的潜力。

title: Trust What Repeats: Capped World-Model Policy Gradients for Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Training a humanoid motion tracker by backpropagating imagined returns through a learned world model is fast, because the model gives a first-order policy gradient. We ask how much of that gradient holds in the simulator. On a tracker for the Unitree G1, the $0.5\%$ of imagined rollouts with the largest gradients carry $22\%$ of the summed gradient norm, yet neither a second rollout from the same state nor the simulator confirms them. When the actions are moved along the model's gradient, the simulator returns 94% of the predicted change in return where the gradient norm is below the batch median, 48% between 3 and 10 times the median, and 1% above 30 times; the part of a gradient that either check confirms stops growing at a few times the median. We therefore cap each rollout's action-gradient norm at 10 times the batch median, draw imagination starts in proportion to their predicted gradient norm so that the cap removes less, and reset episodes where the world model and critic predict the lowest return. Trained on 223 hours of motion and tested on 353 motions that no actor performed in training, the method raises the normalized return of SuperMimic, the baseline it builds on, from 0.953 to 0.967 and the lowest $1\%$ of test clips from 0.65 to 0.76, halves the test clips that fall persistently, from 15--18 to 7--10, and reaches the baseline's final return in 40% of the baseline's iterations and half its training time. On LAFAN1, trained and evaluated on the same clips as prior work, it reaches 0.935 against 0.906.

AI.title_zh: 信任重复出现的部分：用于人形运动跟踪的截断世界模型策略梯度
AI.abstract_zh: 通过将想象回报经学习到的世界模型反向传播来训练人形运动跟踪器速度很快，因为该模型给出的是一阶策略梯度。我们考察这一梯度在模拟器中有多少能够成立。在一个用于 Unitree G1 的跟踪器上，梯度最大的 $0.5\%$ 想象 rollout 承载了总梯度范数的 $22\%$，然而无论是由同一状态出发的第二次 rollout 还是模拟器都无法证实它们。当沿模型梯度移动动作时，在梯度范数低于批次中位数的位置，模拟器返回了预测回报变化的 94%；在 3 至 10 倍中位数之间返回 48%；在 30 倍以上仅返回 1%；而两种检验中任一能够证实的梯度部分会在达到中位数的数倍时停止增长。因此，我们将每个 rollout 的动作梯度范数截断在批次中位数的 10 倍，按预测梯度范数成比例地抽取想象起点，使截断所移除的部分更少，并重置世界模型与评论家预测回报最低的回合。在 223 小时的动捕数据上训练，并在训练中没有任何演员表演过的 353 个动作上测试，该方法将其所基于的基线 SuperMimic 的归一化回报从 0.953 提高到 0.967，并将测试片段中最低的 $1\%$ 从 0.65 提高到 0.76，使持续失败的测试片段减半，从 15--18 降至 7--10，并在基线所需迭代次数的 40%、训练时间的一半达到基线的最终回报。在 LAFAN1 上，与先前工作使用相同的片段进行训练和评估，它达到 0.935，而对比为 0.906。

title: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short imagined rollouts. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world ALOHA robot show that LS-MBPO achieves superior task performance and training efficiency compared to existing methods.

AI.title_zh: 通过潜在世界模型中的子块展开实现高效 VLA 强化学习
AI.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）可以通过想象经验来改进预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。然而，现有的 VLA-MBRL 方法主要依赖大规模图像或视频生成世界模型，带来巨大的计算开销。潜在世界模型（latent world models）提供了一种更高效的替代方案，但面临两个挑战：递归预测期间的误差累积，以及与 VLA 视觉输入接口的不兼容。在本工作中，我们提出 LS-MBPO，一个轻量级残差 MBRL 框架，利用潜在世界模型来改进预训练的 VLA。LS-MBPO 引入两项关键技术：（1）分层强制（Hierarchical Forcing），将稠密因果监督与自回归反馈相结合，以缓解累积的预测误差；（2）潜在子块展开（Latent Subchunk Rollouts），利用来自冻结 VLA 策略的动作块（action chunks）以及一个潜在残差策略进行连续的子块细化，从而弥合潜在想象与 VLA 策略执行之间的差距。我们进一步引入进度条件分支起点课程（Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum），它逐步将展开起点从任务后期阶段移向任务早期阶段，使得能够从短的想象展开中进行有效的策略学习。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 以及一台真实世界 ALOHA 机器人上的大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，LS-MBPO 取得了更优的任务性能和训练效率。

title: SOAR: Training-Free Rank-Consistent Rollout Compression for Latent World Model Planning
comment: 16 pages, including supplementary material. Anqi Li and Kai Liu contributed equally
summary: Latent world models plan by rolling out hundreds of candidate action sequences through a transformer predictor, so a single decision can take tens of seconds. Existing accelerations prune spatial tokens as in vision-language models, yet a sampling-based planner uses predicted costs only to rank candidates, so a rollout can be compressed freely as long as the ranking survives. We propose SOAR, a training-free method that adapts rollout compression to each planning decision. At every decision, SOAR probes a few candidates under several token budgets and keeps the smallest budget that preserves their ranking, so it compresses as far as the current decision allows, without task labels. A closed-loop study of more than 80,000 episodes fixes the rest of the rollout: the first step, which alone reads a real observation, stays exact, and the context frame is cached rather than recomputed. On seven navigation and manipulation tasks with frozen checkpoints, SOAR matches dense-level planning success at 2.3x speedup and retains 98% at 2.5x. Our code is available at https://github.com/starrywiki/SOAR.

AI.title_zh: SOAR：面向潜在世界模型规划的无训练秩一致展开压缩
AI.abstract_zh: 潜在世界模型通过 transformer 预测器展开数百条候选动作序列来进行规划，因此单次决策可能耗时数十秒。现有加速方法沿用视觉-语言模型中的做法裁剪空间 token，然而基于采样的规划器仅利用预测代价对候选进行排序，因此只要排序得以保持，展开过程就可以被自由压缩。我们提出 SOAR，一种无训练方法，可根据每次规划决策自适应地调整展开压缩。在每次决策时，SOAR 在若干 token 预算下探测少数候选，并保留能够维持其排序的最小预算，从而在当前决策允许的范围内尽可能压缩，且无需任务标签。一项超过 80,000 个回合的闭环研究固定了展开过程的其余部分：第一步（唯一读取真实观测的步骤）保持精确，上下文帧则被缓存而非重新计算。在七个导航与操作任务上，使用冻结的检查点，SOAR 在 2.3 倍加速下达到与稠密级规划相同的成功率，并在 2.5 倍加速下保持 98%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/starrywiki/SOAR 获取。

title: Synthesizing Expressive Human-Object Interactions via Test-time Latent Adaptation
summary: When interacting with objects of unknown physical properties, humans sometimes probe, over-exert, stagger, and adjust through iterative adaptation instead of succeeding immediately. We argue that this process is an expressive but largely overlooked aspect of human-object interaction in motion synthesis. Both kinematic data-driven methods and physics-based controllers tend to produce flawlessly executed motions: the former lack sufficient data for learning fine-grained adaptation, while the latter use reinforcement learning (RL) and privileged object dynamics to learn robust, deterministic behaviors. We propose ExpHOI (Expressive Human-Object Interaction), a test-time latent adaptation framework built on an RL-trained physics-based control policy. During policy training, we encode diverse object dynamics contexts into a structured latent space. At test time, Advantage-Weighted Regression (AWR) iteratively optimizes the latent code for an object with unknown physical properties. Temporary mismatches between this code and the true object dynamics produce an expressive progression from tentative, error-prone trials to proficient interaction. Adaptation behaviors inevitably come with occasional failures, so a high-level planner is introduced to handle failed cases to maintain full, consistent animations. We demonstrate our framework's effectiveness on a large-object transportation task, where such adaptation is especially pronounced. To train our framework, we introduce a mass-diverse object dataset with rich physical-property annotations. Across carrying and push-pull, our method pairs over 90% success with markedly higher posture diversity, and is rated the most lifelike in our user study on animation liveliness.

AI.title_zh: 通过测试时隐变量自适应合成富有表现力的人-物交互
AI.abstract_zh: 当与物理属性未知的物体交互时，人类有时会通过反复尝试、过度用力、踉跄以及迭代调整来适应，而非一开始就成功。我们认为，这一过程是运动合成中人体-物体交互（human-object interaction）一个富有表现力但很大程度上被忽视的方面。基于运动学数据的驱动方法与基于物理的控制器往往都会产生执行得天衣无缝的动作：前者缺乏足够的数据来学习细粒度的适应行为，而后者使用强化学习（RL）和特权物体动力学（privileged object dynamics）来学习鲁棒、确定性的行为。我们提出 ExpHOI（Expressive Human-Object Interaction，富有表现力的人-物交互），一个构建在经 RL 训练的基于物理的控制策略之上的测试时隐变量自适应框架。在策略训练期间，我们将多样的物体动力学上下文编码到一个结构化的隐空间（latent space）中。在测试时，优势加权回归（Advantage-Weighted Regression, AWR）针对一个物理属性未知的物体迭代优化隐变量编码。该编码与真实物体动力学之间的暂时不匹配，会产生从试探性、易出错的尝试到熟练交互的富有表现力的渐进过程。适应行为不可避免地伴随着偶发失败，因此引入一个高层规划器来处理失败情形，以维持完整、连贯的动画。我们在一个大件物体搬运任务上展示了该框架的有效性，在该任务中此类适应行为尤为显著。为训练我们的框架，我们引入了一个带有丰富物理属性标注的质量多样化物体数据集。在搬运与推拉任务中，我们的方法将超过 90% 的成功率与显著更高的姿态多样性相结合，并在我们关于动画生动性的用户研究中被评为最逼真。

title: GameScrub: Learning HUD Removal from Real Gameplay with Recovered Targets
summary: Gameplay videos are a rich source of experience for learning virtual-world dynamics, yet their frames contain heads-up displays (HUDs) that follow interface rules rather than scene dynamics. Removing HUDs would make this footage directly usable for learning world dynamics. However, training a removal model requires paired clips with and without HUDs, whereas real recordings contain only HUD-overlaid footage. Existing work synthesizes pairs by compositing HUD graphics onto HUD-free footage, requiring a separately curated clean corpus and producing HUDs that only approximate real ones. Models trained on such pairs leave 40 to 50% of real HUD elements untouched. We instead recover pseudo-clean targets directly from real recordings by inpainting HUD regions with a pretrained video diffusion model. Preventing HUD traces from leaking into recovered targets is challenging because latent video autoencoders mix information across mask boundaries. Our training-free recovery pipeline, GameScrub-Data, pre-fills HUD regions with flow-guided background estimates before encoding, excludes HUDs from scene conditioning, and confines restoration to masked regions through pixel-space compositing. The resulting pairs train GameScrub, a video diffusion removal model that handles diverse HUDs without inference-time masks or clean reference images. On the in-the-wild Game2World benchmark, GameScrub achieves an artifact-adjusted removal score of 71.95, compared with 57.86 for the strongest reference-free GameCleaner configuration, and removes 90.06% of annotated HUD elements versus 59.07%. These results demonstrate that real recordings with recovered targets can support effective HUD removal, advancing HUD-free gameplay data for world models and controllable video generation.

AI.title_zh: GameScrub：利用恢复目标从真实游戏画面中学习 HUD 移除
AI.abstract_zh: 游戏视频是学习虚拟世界动态的丰富经验来源，然而其帧中包含平视显示（heads-up display，HUD），这些元素遵循的是界面规则而非场景动态。移除 HUD 将使这些视频素材可直接用于学习世界动态。然而，训练一个移除模型需要带有和不带 HUD 的成对片段，而真实录制只包含叠加了 HUD 的素材。现有工作通过将 HUD 图形合成到无 HUD 素材上来构造成对数据，这需要一个单独筛选的干净语料库，并且生成的 HUD 只能近似真实 HUD。在这类成对数据上训练的模型会遗漏 40% 到 50% 的真实 HUD 元素。我们则改为用预训练视频扩散模型对 HUD 区域进行修复（inpainting），从而直接从真实录制中恢复伪干净目标。防止 HUD 痕迹泄漏到恢复目标中具有挑战性，因为潜空间视频自编码器会跨越掩码边界混合信息。我们无需训练的恢复流程 GameScrub-Data 在编码前用流引导的背景估计预填充 HUD 区域，将 HUD 排除在场景条件之外，并通过像素空间合成将恢复限制在掩码区域内。由此得到的成对数据用于训练 GameScrub，这是一个视频扩散移除模型，无需推理时掩码或干净参考图像即可处理多样化的 HUD。在真实场景的 Game2World 基准上，GameScrub 取得了 71.95 的伪影校正移除分数，而最强的无参考 GameCleaner 配置为 57.86；同时它移除了 90.06% 的标注 HUD 元素，而后者为 59.07%。这些结果表明，带有恢复目标的真实录制能够支持有效的 HUD 移除，从而推动面向世界模型和可控视频生成的无 HUD 游戏数据的发展。

title: PhiJEPA: Denoising Latent Predictions for Visual Representation Learning
summary: Can a predictor trained to infer hidden image regions still help a world model plan when part of an object disappears from view and the visible context is blurred? We introduce PhiJEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that adapts PhiNet's two-stage prediction to masked Transformers. From sparse, photometrically corrupted context, a Transformer block predicts hidden tokens of an independently corrupted teacher view. A token-wise MLP then maps these predictions to clean teacher tokens. Controlled ablations show that the combined objective improves dense features over the tested one-stage alternatives. Pre-trained on ImageNet-1K with $5.6\times10^{19}$ training FLOPs, PhiJEPA achieves 69.3 mIoU on linear PASCAL VOC segmentation, exceeding the evaluated I-JEPA and DSeq-JEPA checkpoints in segmentation accuracy, with 25\% fewer training FLOPs than I-JEPA. It also improves hidden-region segmentation over Simple I-JEPA (49.1 vs.\ 44.3 mIoU). As an application, we use the frozen encoder in DINO-WM on PushT, and reuse the pre-training predictor, which JEPAs usually discard, to complete occluded tokens without fine-tuning. In open-loop planning with simultaneous object occlusion and Gaussian blur ($σ=2$ pixels), predictor completion raises success from 33\% to 65\%, compared with 25\% for Simple I-JEPA with its predictor and 40\% for iBOT with pixel inpainting. Together, these results support two-stage latent prediction as an efficient approach to learning visual representations that remain useful under photometric degradation and support completion under partial observation.

AI.title_zh: PhiJEPA：面向视觉表征学习的去噪潜在预测
AI.abstract_zh: 一个被训练用于推断隐藏图像区域的预测器，能否在物体的一部分从视野中消失且可见上下文变得模糊时，仍然帮助世界模型进行规划？我们提出 PhiJEPA，这是一种联合嵌入预测架构（joint-embedding predictive architecture），它将 PhiNet 的两阶段预测适配到掩码 Transformer 上。基于稀疏且受光度损坏的上下文，一个 Transformer 块预测独立损坏的教师视图的隐藏 token。随后，一个逐 token 的 MLP 将这些预测映射到干净的教师 token。受控消融实验表明，与所测试的单阶段替代方案相比，该组合目标能改善稠密特征。PhiJEPA 在 ImageNet-1K 上以 $5.6\times10^{19}$ 的训练 FLOPs 进行预训练，在线性 PASCAL VOC 分割上达到 69.3 mIoU，在分割准确率上超过所评估的 I-JEPA 和 DSeq-JEPA 检查点，且训练 FLOPs 比 I-JEPA 少 25\%。它还在隐藏区域分割上优于 Simple I-JEPA（49.1 对 44.3 mIoU）。作为一项应用，我们将冻结的编码器用于 PushT 上的 DINO-WM，并复用预训练预测器（JEPA 通常将其丢弃）在无需微调的情况下补全被遮挡的 token。在同时存在物体遮挡与高斯模糊（$σ=2$ 像素）的开环规划中，预测器补全将成功率从 33\% 提升至 65\%，相比之下，使用其预测器的 Simple I-JEPA 为 25\%，使用像素修复（pixel inpainting）的 iBOT 为 40\%。这些结果共同支持将两阶段潜在预测作为一种高效方法，用于学习在光度退化下仍然有用、并支持部分观测下补全的视觉表征。

title: Ego4Gen: Generating Geometry-Grounded Motion Tokens as a World-Action Interface
summary: We present Ego4Gen (Egocentric 4D Future Generation), a world model for 4D future generation in robotic manipu lation. Given a single egocentric image and a text prompt, Ego4Gen jointly generates temporally aligned RGB frames, dense point maps, and dense scene flow, explicitly pre dicting the evolution of scene appearance, spatial struc ture, and motion. Built on Cosmos3-Nano, Ego4Gen ex tends the pretrained generative backbone through modality routed LoRA and asymmetric attention, using geometric pseudo-labels from MotionCrafter to learn to predict future geometry and motion latents. These latents can either be decoded into explicit 3D structure and motion or mapped to robot actions. To this end, we also introduce FlowIn verse, a lightweight inverse dynamics network trained in two stages to translate predicted 4D latents into robot ac tions. Experiments show that these geometry and motion latents outperform the evaluated latent-action and video latent baselines in out-of-distribution settings. Closed loop policy evaluations further demonstrate their utility for translating predicted 4D futures into robot control. To gether, these results support geometry-grounded motion to kens as a world-action interface, connecting 4D future gen eration with robotic manipulation and suggesting a path to ward reduced reliance on action-labeled data.

AI.title_zh: Ego4Gen：生成以几何为基的运动令牌作为世界-动作接口
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Ego4Gen（Egocentric 4D Future Generation，第一人称 4D 未来生成），这是一个用于机器人操作中 4D 未来生成的世界模型。给定单张第一人称图像和文本提示，Ego4Gen 联合生成时间对齐的 RGB 帧、稠密点图（dense point maps）和稠密场景流（dense scene flow），显式预测场景外观、空间结构和运动的演化。Ego4Gen 构建于 Cosmos3-Nano 之上，通过模态路由 LoRA（modality-routed LoRA）和非对称注意力（asymmetric attention）扩展预训练生成主干，并利用来自 MotionCrafter 的几何伪标签学习预测未来的几何与运动潜变量（latents）。这些潜变量既可以被解码为显式的 3D 结构和运动，也可以被映射为机器人动作。为此，我们还引入了 FlowInverse，一个轻量级逆动力学网络，分两阶段训练，用于将预测的 4D 潜变量转化为机器人动作。实验表明，在分布外（out-of-distribution）设置下，这些几何与运动潜变量优于所评估的潜动作（latent-action）和视频潜变量（video latent）基线。闭环策略评估进一步证明了它们在将预测的 4D 未来转化为机器人控制方面的实用性。综合来看，这些结果支持将以几何为基的运动令牌（geometry-grounded motion tokens）作为世界-动作接口，将 4D 未来生成与机器人操作相连接，并指向一条减少对动作标注数据依赖的路径。

title: Efficient Natural Language to Temporal Logic Translation for Real-Time Physical AI
summary: Robots can be controlled to perform tasks with guaranteed correctness when the task instructions are stated in a formal language. Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used to allow users to provide such instructions in natural language (NL), by translating NL into formal language. When deploying such translators on a robot, however, we face limited computing and energy resources, while offloading computation or data to the cloud may be infeasible or undesirable. Yet an LLM is a general-purpose text generator, whereas a formula in a fixed formal language fragment follows a well-defined syntax. We therefore ask whether text generation is needed at all. For the formal language of linear temporal logic (LTL), we show that this translation can instead be broken down into answering a set of questions with pre-defined answers. We then construct a System-One model, a recent class of NL-based classifier, to provide such answers and enable us to translate a natural language instruction into an LTL instruction. On three benchmarks, our translator matches or exceeds the accuracy of the best local LLMs available, at up to one order of magnitude lower runtime and energy consumption. We show that it generalizes to unseen atomic propositions and temporal patterns.

AI.title_zh: 面向实时物理AI的高效自然语言到时序逻辑翻译
AI.abstract_zh: 当任务指令以形式语言表述时，机器人可以被控制以具有正确性保证的方式执行任务。大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛用于让用户以自然语言（NL）提供此类指令，即将自然语言翻译为形式语言。然而，当在机器人上部署此类翻译器时，我们面临有限的计算与能量资源，而将计算或数据卸载到云端可能不可行或不可取。此外，LLM是一个通用文本生成器，而固定形式语言片段中的公式遵循定义良好的语法。因此我们提出疑问：是否真的需要文本生成？对于线性时序逻辑（LTL）这一形式语言，我们表明该翻译可以改为分解为回答一组具有预定义答案的问题。随后，我们构建了一个System-One模型——一类近期的基于自然语言的分类器——来提供此类答案，并使我们能够将自然语言指令翻译为LTL指令。在三个基准上，我们的翻译器在准确率上达到或超过了现有最佳本地LLM，而运行时间和能量消耗最多低一个数量级。我们表明它能够泛化到未见过的原子命题和时序模式。

title: Ego2Ego: Generative Visual Perspective Taking Across Collaborators
summary: Visual perspective taking, the ability to infer what another person sees from their position, is fundamental to human collaboration. However, prior works reduced perspective taking to state estimation, geometric reconstruction, or discrete question answering, whereas existing cross-view video generation methods either inferred the target view from the input video alone or required an external camera that observes the target person. We introduce generative visual perspective taking: Given an ego person's egocentric video, a scene point cloud, and a collaborator's camera trajectory, the task is to generate the continuous egocentric video from the collaborator's perspective. This task is challenging given extreme viewpoint shifts, dynamic occlusions, and sparse visual overlap. We address these challenges with Ego2Ego -- a set of backbone-agnostic geometric modules that provide a pretrained video diffusion model with the 3D scene geometry shared by both interactants. Ego2Ego renders dense, temporally consistent scene coordinate maps into every view as a shared spatial reference, aligns cross-view tokens in 3D ray space through relative geometric attention, and recovers regions outside the ego person's current view from the ego person's visual memory. Experiments on the CoMind dataset across three video diffusion backbones show that Ego2Ego consistently improves visual quality, Level-2 scene layout accuracy, and collaborator motion, outperforming state-of-the-art cross-view video generation baselines on every backbone. By generating the collaborator's egocentric video more accurately, Ego2Ego brings visual perspective taking to human-robot collaboration, where it can help infer what a human collaborator sees and does, and can turn single-person recordings into synchronised multi-perspective videos for robot learning.

AI.title_zh: Ego2Ego：跨协作者的生成式视觉视角采择
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉视角采择，即从他人的位置推断其所能看到的内容的能力，是人类协作的基础。然而，先前的工作将视角采择简化为状态估计、几何重建或离散问答，而现有的跨视角视频生成方法要么仅从输入视频推断目标视角，要么需要一台观察目标人物的外部相机。我们提出生成式视觉视角采择：给定一个自我主体（ego person）的第一人称视角视频、一个场景点云，以及一名协作者的相机轨迹，任务是从协作者的视角生成连续的第一人称视角视频。鉴于极端的视角变化、动态遮挡和稀疏的视觉重叠，该任务极具挑战性。我们通过 Ego2Ego 来应对这些挑战——Ego2Ego 是一组与骨干网络无关的几何模块，为预训练的视频扩散模型提供两个交互者共享的 3D 场景几何。Ego2Ego 将稠密、时间一致（temporally consistent）的场景坐标图渲染到每个视角中，作为共享的空间参考；通过相对几何注意力在 3D 射线空间中跨视角对齐 token；并从自我主体的视觉记忆中恢复自我主体当前视野之外的区域。在 CoMind 数据集上跨三种视频扩散骨干网络的实验表明，Ego2Ego 在视觉质量、Level-2 场景布局准确性和协作者运动方面均取得一致的提升，并在每一种骨干网络上均优于最先进的跨视角视频生成基线。通过更准确地生成协作者的第一人称视角视频，Ego2Ego 将视觉视角采择引入人-机器人协作，在其中它可以帮助推断人类协作者所看到的内容与所做之事，并可将单人录制转换为用于机器人学习的同步多视角视频。

title: Beyond Future Views: Exploring Future-State World Models for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through unseen 3D environments, where the target spaces often lie beyond the current observation. Navigation world models address this challenge by predicting future views either as pixels or latent representations, providing valuable look-ahead information for action decision. Both paradigms define the future primarily through what the agent may observe, raising a fundamental question: is predicting future views the ultimate form to represent the future for VLN? Cognitive studies show that the human hippocampus prospectively represents both future goals and intervening locations along planned routes. Inspired by this predictive-map view, we organize the navigation-relevant future around goal-directed spatial states and route structure. We instantiate this perspective with two complementary abstractions: a short-horizon waypoint that specifies the next local state to reach, and a mid-horizon corridor that captures the spatial support of the upcoming route. Based on this design, we propose FS-Nav, a future-state world modeling framework that predicts waypoint-corridor states from spatial memory and language instructions, and communicates them to a VLM navigator through top-down and first-person interfaces. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that FS-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance. This highlights navigation-relevant future-state modeling as a promising direction for representing the future in VLN.

AI.title_zh: 超越未来视图：探索面向视觉语言导航的未来状态世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言导航（Vision-Language Navigation, VLN）要求具身智能体在未见过的三维环境中遵循语言指令，而目标空间往往位于当前观测之外。导航世界模型通过以像素或潜在表示的形式预测未来视图来应对这一挑战，为动作决策提供有价值的预见性信息。这两种范式主要都是通过智能体可能观测到的内容来界定未来，这引出了一个根本性问题：预测未来视图是表示 VLN 未来的终极形式吗？认知研究表明，人类海马体能够前瞻性地表征未来目标以及规划路线上途经的位置。受这种预测地图（predictive-map）视角的启发，我们围绕目标导向的空间状态和路线结构来组织与导航相关的未来。我们以两种互补的抽象来实例化这一视角：短时域的航点（waypoint），用于指定下一个要到达的局部状态；以及中时域的走廊（corridor），用于捕捉即将到来的路线的空间支撑。基于这一设计，我们提出了 FS-Nav，一个未来状态世界建模框架，它从空间记忆和语言指令中预测航点-走廊状态，并通过自上而下和第一人称两种接口将其传达给 VLM 导航器。在标准 VLN 基准上的实验表明，FS-Nav 达到了最先进的性能。这凸显了与导航相关的未来状态建模是表示 VLN 未来的一个有前景的方向。

title: Show Me the Answer: Visual Grounding on Dashboards
summary: Natural language interaction has become an increasingly important paradigm for accessing complex visual information systems. In visual data analytics environments, such as dashboards, a key capability is to ground user queries to specific visual elements, enabling systems to identify the visual evidence relevant to the query. However, existing visual grounding research has primarily focused on natural images, while grounding in dashboards remains underexplored due to their complex multi-chart layouts and fine-grained visual elements. In this paper, we study the task of Visual Grounding on Dashboards (VGD): Given a dashboard screenshot and a natural language query, the goal is to localize the visual element corresponding to the query using a bounding box. We propose VGD-Net, a two-stage grounding framework that reflects how users typically locate information in dashboards, by first performing query-aware chart retrieval and then fine-grained in-chart grounding. To systematically evaluate VGD-Net's performance on this task, we construct VGD-Bench, a benchmark specifically designed for VGD, covering three complementary settings: chart retrieval, in-chart grounding, and overall VGD. Experimental results show that our two-stage VGD-Net outperforms strong multimodal baselines on the VGD task, achieving a mean IoU of 57.06 and a success rate of 66.82, while also delivering superior performance over existing methods in both stages of chart retrieval and in-chart grounding. These results highlight the value of stage decomposition for reliable and interpretable VGD, and its potential to support query-driven visual analysis.

AI.title_zh: 告诉我答案：仪表板上的视觉定位
AI.abstract_zh: 自然语言交互已成为访问复杂视觉信息系统日益重要的一种范式。在诸如仪表板之类的可视化数据分析环境中，一项关键能力是将用户查询定位（ground）到特定的视觉元素，从而使系统能够识别与查询相关的视觉证据。然而，现有的视觉定位研究主要集中于自然图像，而由于仪表板具有复杂的多图表布局和细粒度视觉元素，仪表板中的定位问题仍未得到充分探索。本文研究了仪表板上的视觉定位（Visual Grounding on Dashboards, VGD）任务：给定一张仪表板截图和一条自然语言查询，目标是使用边界框（bounding box）定位与该查询对应的视觉元素。我们提出 VGD-Net，这是一个两阶段定位框架，它反映了用户在仪表板中定位信息的典型方式，即先执行查询感知的图表检索，然后进行细粒度的图表内定位。为了系统地评估 VGD-Net 在该任务上的性能，我们构建了 VGD-Bench，这是一个专门为 VGD 设计的基准，涵盖三种互补的设置：图表检索、图表内定位和整体 VGD。实验结果表明，我们的两阶段 VGD-Net 在 VGD 任务上优于强大的多模态基线，取得了 57.06 的平均 IoU 和 66.82 的成功率，同时在图表检索和图表内定位这两个阶段上也都优于现有方法。这些结果凸显了阶段分解对于可靠且可解释的 VGD 的价值，以及其支持查询驱动的可视化分析的潜力。

title: Learning Interaction Dynamics via Motion-Region Guidance for Robotic Video World Models
summary: Action-conditioned video world models imagine future observations under candidate robot actions, providing a promising visual tool for robot policy evaluation and interaction simulation. However, existing video world models often optimize global reconstruction errors instead of emphasizing interaction-relevant regions. As a result, they may preserve overall scene appearance but overlook local interaction details, leading to physically implausible outcomes such as hallucinated contact effects and inconsistent robot-object interactions. We introduce MoReWorld, a unified motion-region-guided framework that uses a shared motion region, the part of the environment that moves in response to the robot's actions, to focus dynamics learning and video generation on interaction-relevant regions. The same motion region guides local motion prediction, region-aware supervision, and motion-gated future-feature conditioning. At inference time, the motion region is predicted as a motion probability map from visual history and robot actions, without requiring future observations or ground-truth motion labels. On WorldSimProbe, MoReWorld achieves the highest overall simulator-faithfulness score, with the strongest performance on local consistency, global consistency, and interaction dynamics. These results indicate that motion-region guidance helps the model preserve scene-level consistency while more faithfully predicting action-conditioned interaction dynamics.

AI.title_zh: 通过运动区域引导学习交互动力学以实现机器人视频世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 以动作为条件的视频世界模型在候选机器人动作下想象未来的观测，为机器人策略评估与交互仿真提供了一种有前景的视觉工具。然而，现有的视频世界模型往往优化全局重建误差，而非强调与交互相关的区域。因此，它们可能保留整体场景外观，却忽视局部交互细节，导致物理上不合理的结果，例如幻觉的接触效应以及不一致的机器人—物体交互。我们提出了 MoReWorld，一个统一的运动区域引导框架，它使用一个共享的运动区域——即环境中响应机器人动作而发生移动的部分——来将动力学学习与视频生成聚焦于与交互相关的区域。同一运动区域引导局部运动预测、区域感知监督以及运动门控的未来特征条件化。在推理时，运动区域被预测为基于视觉历史和机器人动作的运动概率图，无需未来观测或真实运动标签。在 WorldSimProbe 上，MoReWorld 取得了最高的整体模拟器保真度得分，在局部一致性、全局一致性和交互动力学方面表现最强。这些结果表明，运动区域引导有助于模型在保持场景级一致性的同时，更忠实地预测以动作为条件的交互动力学。

title: Budgeted Safety Verification for Streaming Video Generation
summary: A streamed video generator releases each chunk the moment that it is produced, so a safety decision that waits for the finished clip arrives after the harm has been seen. We measure a guardrail by exposure, the harmful frames a viewer is shown, and ask where a fixed moderation budget should be spent. The accurate detector reads decoded frames with a video language model and is too expensive for every chunk, so our guard reads hidden states the generator has computed already and spends a cheap score on deciding when to call it. On 599 streams from a distilled causal generator the undefended model shows 46.25 harmful frames of 81. The video model on every chunk leaves 0.91 frames at 80.1 scored per benign stream, and the same model triggered by our guard leaves 2.35 at 5.3. Spending that budget at random leaves 37.20 frames, so the gain is in the ordering, and a frame detector in the same role gives up almost six, so the judging stage must read the chunk as a clip. The ordering is worth more as the stream lengthens, and the guard carries to a second system. An independent guardrail model agrees with our oracle at $κ=0.74$, and a blinded audit by 50 participants puts its precision at 96.1% and recall at 82.8%. Warning. This paper contains examples of generated content that some readers may find disturbing or offensive in nature.

AI.title_zh: 流式视频生成的有预算安全验证
AI.abstract_zh: 流式视频生成器在每一段（chunk）产生的那一刻就将其释放，因此等待完整片段生成完毕再做出的安全决策，会在危害已被看到之后才到达。我们以暴露度（exposure）——即观看者被展示的有害帧数——来衡量一道护栏（guardrail），并追问固定的审核预算应当花在哪里。精确的检测器用视频语言模型读取解码后的帧，对每个数据块而言代价过高，因此我们的防护机制读取生成器已经计算出的隐藏状态，并用一个廉价的分数来决定何时调用它。在来自一个蒸馏因果生成器的 599 条流上，无防护的模型在 81 帧中展示了 46.25 个有害帧。对每个数据块都运行视频模型的做法，在 80.1 的有评分/每条良性流下留下 0.91 帧，而由我们的防护机制触发的同一模型则留下 2.35 帧，评分为 5.3。将该预算随机花费会留下 37.20 帧，因此增益来自排序，而同一角色下的帧检测器则多放弃近六帧，所以判定阶段必须将该数据块作为一个片段来读取。随着流的延长，排序的价值更大，且该防护机制可迁移到第二个系统。一个独立的护栏模型与我们的 oracle 在 $\kappa=0.74$ 上一致，而由 50 名参与者进行的盲审将其精确率定为 96.1%、召回率定为 82.8%。警告。本文包含一些生成内容的示例，某些读者可能会觉得令人不安或具有冒犯性。

title: PP-CFG: Polarity-Preserving Guidance for Controllable Few-Step Image and Video Generation
summary: Few-step diffusion distillation reduces sampling cost but often weakens adjustable classifier-free guidance (CFG) and runtime negative prompting. We introduce PP-CFG, an architecture that keeps positive and negative text conditions separate and combines their attention responses with opposite signs within a shared visual backbone. Its Scale-Time Polarity Mixer refines each condition using the guidance scale and denoising timestep, allowing prompt influence to vary throughout generation. The student retains a continuous scale input and selectable negative prompts with one visual backbone pass per step. We evaluate PP-CFG on Wan2.1 for video generation with distribution matching distillation (DMD), and on Qwen-Image with both latent consistency model (LCM) distillation and DMD. PP-CFG achieves 81.46 VBench in four steps and lower video teacher-student distances across guidance scales than step-distilled DMD. On NegElement-1K, our benchmark of 1,000 matched image and video prompt cases, it achieves higher target-removal rates than the corresponding teachers. These experiments support the method's generality across attention architectures, generation modalities, and distillation objectives while retaining competitive generation quality.

AI.title_zh: PP-CFG：面向可控少步图像与视频生成的极性保持引导
AI.abstract_zh: 少步扩散蒸馏降低了采样成本，但往往会削弱可调节的无分类器引导（CFG）以及运行时的负向提示。我们提出 PP-CFG，这是一种将正向与负向文本条件保持分离、并在共享视觉主干内以相反符号组合其注意力响应的架构。其 Scale-Time Polarity Mixer 利用引导尺度与去噪时间步对每个条件进行细化，使提示的影响能够在整个生成过程中变化。学生模型保留连续的尺度输入与可选择的负向提示，且每步仅需一次视觉主干前向。我们在 Wan2.1 上以分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）评估 PP-CFG 的视频生成，并在 Qwen-Image 上同时以潜一致性模型（LCM）蒸馏与 DMD 进行评估。PP-CFG 在四步下取得 81.46 的 VBench 分数，并在各引导尺度下取得比步蒸馏 DMD 更低的视频师生距离。在我们构建的包含 1,000 个图像与视频配对提示案例的基准 NegElement-1K 上，它取得了比相应教师模型更高的目标移除率。这些实验支持了该方法在注意力架构、生成模态与蒸馏目标上的通用性，同时保持了有竞争力的生成质量。

title: Beyond Prompt Imitation: Capability-Aware Video Generation with Smaller Models
summary: Inference-time methods that lift a small open video generator toward a proprietary one are compared through preference scores, which never say how much of the gap to a target video they close. We introduce the oracle control ladder, which hands a fixed student progressively richer information from a target clip and reads the closure of each fidelity metric at each rung as an empirical headroom reference for the methods that must synthesize that information. On 954 clips of the principal student, a dense caption reproduces little of the appearance and almost none of the motion of a target, a first frame closes half of the appearance gap and a tenth of the motion gap, a depth video closes three quarters of the motion gap and leaves color untouched, and the two together close 64 to 94% of every fidelity gap across four teachers, while a second student agrees on the rungs that it accepts. An item response model forecasts which rung closes which clip with held-out AUC of 0.76 to 0.95 on the fidelity criteria and serves as the prior of a budgeted selection policy. When controls are free, a fixed dense-control rung is hard to improve upon, and once controls are priced the policy lies above the fixed-rung frontier at matched cost and survives critics that ruin critic-driven search.

AI.title_zh: 超越提示模仿：面向能力感知的小模型视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 将小型开源视频生成器推向专有视频生成器的推理时方法，目前仅通过偏好分数进行比较，而这些分数从不说明它们缩小了与目标视频之间差距的多少。我们引入了 oracle control ladder（神谕控制阶梯），它在每一级向固定的学生模型逐步提供来自目标片段的更丰富信息，并将每一级上每个保真度指标的闭合程度解读为对那些必须自行合成该信息的方法的经验性余量参照。在主体学生模型的 954 个片段上，密集描述几乎无法复现目标的外观，也几乎完全无法复现其运动；首帧闭合了外观差距的一半和运动差距的十分之一；深度视频闭合了运动差距的四分之三，但不影响颜色；二者结合则在四个教师模型上闭合了每一项保真度差距的 64% 至 94%，而第二个学生模型在其所接受的各个级别上保持一致。一个项目反应模型预测哪一级别能闭合哪个片段，在保真度标准上取得 0.76 至 0.95 的留出 AUC，并作为预算受限的选择策略的先验。当控制信息免费时，固定的密集控制级别难以被超越；而一旦控制信息被计价，该策略在同等成本下位于固定级别前沿之上，并能经受住那些会毁掉由批评者驱动的搜索的批评者。

title: PACE-WM: Parallel World Modeling with Action History for Visual Planning
summary: JEPA-style world models support visual planning by predicting future representations conditioned on future actions. However, similar observations can conceal different motion states, making temporal context essential for interpreting future action effects. We propose PACE-WM, a parallel world model that uses executed-action history to contextualize future prediction and planning. Specifically, PACE-WM maintains a recurrent memory of executed actions and uses this memory to condition a causal Transformer. PACE-WM predicts multiple future representations in parallel without recursive predicted-state feedback within each prediction window. We further introduce Reference-Anchored Minimum Progress (RAMP) for action selection during planning. RAMP scores candidate actions by their predicted goal improvement along direct and split paths relative to a shared reference. Across four visual planning tasks, PACE-WM with RAMP achieves an average success rate of $98\%$ and plans approximately $7$-$9\times$ faster than autoregressive LeWM under matched CEM settings. We also construct four controlled benchmarks to evaluate PACE-WM's capabilities in motion disambiguation, goal-relative motion, and goal adaptation. Project page is available at https://github.com/LHS180/PACE-WM.

AI.title_zh: PACE-WM：面向视觉规划的带动作历史的并行世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: JEPA 风格的世界模型通过以未来动作为条件预测未来表征来支持视觉规划。然而，相似的观测可能掩盖不同的运动状态，这使得时间上下文对于解读未来动作的效果至关重要。我们提出 PACE-WM，一种并行世界模型，它利用已执行动作的历史来为未来预测与规划提供上下文。具体而言，PACE-WM 维护一个关于已执行动作的循环记忆，并利用该记忆对因果 Transformer 进行条件化。PACE-WM 并行预测多个未来表征，且在每个预测窗口内不使用递归的预测状态反馈。我们进一步引入参考锚定最小进展（Reference-Anchored Minimum Progress，RAMP）用于规划中的动作选择。RAMP 依据候选动作相对于共享参考沿直接路径与分裂路径所预测的目标改进来对其评分。在四个视觉规划任务上，采用 RAMP 的 PACE-WM 取得了 $98\%$ 的平均成功率，并且在匹配的 CEM 设置下，其规划速度比自回归 LeWM 快约 $7$-$9\times$。我们还构建了四个受控基准，用于评估 PACE-WM 在运动消歧、目标相对运动和目标适应方面的能力。项目页面见 https://github.com/LHS180/PACE-WM。

title: PhysForce: Physics-aware Force Control for Interactive Video World Model
summary: Interactive video world models aim to predict how visual environments evolve in response to user interventions, including physically consistent state changes induced by applied forces. Existing methods often represent forces as motion trajectories, which may introduce inappropriate motion priors, causing the model to over-rely on encoded displacement patterns. More fundamentally, the model's internal representations do not reliably localize force-induced state changes, making it difficult to associate applied forces with their resulting physical responses. Also, limited force-annotated data make it difficult to produce physically consistent and temporally stable predictions in unseen scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose PhysForce, a two-stage framework that integrates supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning through three complementary components. During supervised fine-tuning, (1) the Latent Force Intervention Encoder maps force location, direction, and magnitude into the video latent space without exposing future motion; and (2) the Physics Attribution Network associates force interventions with localized changes in the latent state, strengthening the learning of physical responses to applied forces. During reinforcement learning, (3) Physics-Aware Reinforcement Learning uses self-supervised rewards on out-of-distribution videos to improve physical consistency and generalization. Extensive experiments show that PhysForce improves force responsiveness, physical consistency, and generalization, demonstrating its effectiveness for interactive video world models.

AI.title_zh: PhysForce：面向交互式视频世界模型的物理感知力控制
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式视频世界模型旨在预测视觉环境如何响应用户干预而演化，包括由所施加的力引起的物理一致的状态变化。现有方法通常将力表示为运动轨迹，这可能引入不恰当的运动先验，导致模型过度依赖所编码的位移模式。更根本地，模型的内部表示无法可靠地定位力引起的状态变化，使得难以将所施加的力与其产生的物理响应关联起来。此外，有限的力标注数据使得在未见场景中难以产生物理一致且时间稳定的预测。为解决这些局限，我们提出 PhysForce，这是一个通过三个互补组件将监督微调与强化学习相结合的两阶段框架。在监督微调期间：(1) 隐空间力干预编码器（Latent Force Intervention Encoder）将力的位置、方向和大小映射到视频隐空间，而不暴露未来运动；(2) 物理归因网络（Physics Attribution Network）将力干预与隐状态中的局部化变化相关联，加强对所施加力的物理响应的学习。在强化学习期间：(3) 物理感知强化学习（Physics-Aware Reinforcement Learning）利用在分布外视频上的自监督奖励来提升物理一致性和泛化能力。大量实验表明，PhysForce 提升了力响应性、物理一致性和泛化能力，证明了其对于交互式视频世界模型的有效性。

title: Where Structure Enters a World Model: From Predictive Fit to Physical Rollout
summary: Predictive world models learn to forecast observations, but accurate short-term predictions do not necessarily produce physically coherent behavior over longer horizons. We investigate how incorporating physical structure can strengthen world models while retaining their underlying predictive objectives. Across token-based models of planetary motion and JEPA-style visual models of mechanical systems, we study conserved-quantity supervision, symmetry-aware representations, temporal consistency, and learned structured dynamics. In planetary motion, angular-momentum supervision improves autonomous next-token forecasting, while the benefits of temporal regularization depend on the accompanying physical objective and representation. In visual models, generating rollouts through supervised energy-based dynamics heads produces more faithful trajectories and phase-space evolution. Together, these findings highlight the importance of how physical structure participates in prediction: improvements in an auxiliary physical readout or a local acceleration estimate do not automatically translate into more reliable long-horizon behavior. Evaluations across initial conditions and physical parameter shifts further reveal where these benefits persist and where generalization remains limited. Our study supports physical structure as a practical means of improving predictive world models and provides a unified framework for understanding its effects on representations, learned transitions, and autonomous rollouts. The central lesson is that effective physical inductive biases should help models both represent physical regularities and use them to generate future states.

AI.title_zh: 结构在何处进入世界模型：从预测拟合到物理推演
AI.abstract_zh: 预测式世界模型学习预测观测，但准确的短期预测并不一定能在更长的时间跨度上产生物理上一致的行为。我们研究了引入物理结构如何在保留其底层预测目标的同时增强世界模型。在基于 token 的行星运动模型和 JEPA 风格的机械系统视觉模型上，我们研究了守恒量监督、对称性感知表示、时间一致性以及学习到的结构化动力学。在行星运动中，角动量监督提升了自主的下一 token 预测，而时间正则化的收益取决于与之相伴的物理目标和表示。在视觉模型中，通过监督式基于能量的动力学头生成推演，可产生更忠实的轨迹与相空间演化。综合来看，这些发现凸显了物理结构以何种方式参与预测的重要性：辅助物理读出或局部加速度估计的改进，并不会自动转化为更可靠的长期行为。跨初始条件和物理参数偏移的评估进一步揭示了这些收益在何处得以保持、以及在何处泛化仍然受限。我们的研究支持将物理结构作为改进预测式世界模型的一种实用手段，并提供了一个统一框架来理解其对表示、学习到的状态转移以及自主推演的影响。核心结论是：有效的物理归纳偏置应当帮助模型既能表示物理规律，又能利用这些规律生成未来状态。

title: A Plan or an Adversarial Example? A Round-Trip Check for Latent World Models
summary: If we optimize an image until a classifier is confident it shows a cat, we may get an adversarial example, not a cat. Planning with a latent world model is a similar search for actions whose predicted future is closest to the goal. Is the result a plan, or an adversarial example of the world model? We show that it can be either. On the released DINO-WM and LeWM, more iterations of the cross-entropy method (CEM) lower the predicted cost but lose up to half of the problems CEM had already solved. The model's own predictions do not reveal these failures. We propose a simple test that executes the plan after every iteration and counts the problems a planner solves and then loses. Unlike an image, a plan comes with its actions, which our round-trip check reads back from the predicted states with a small network, penalizing mismatches. The check reads back the sum of each block of five actions, the part that two consecutive predicted states determine. Without retraining the world model and at only 0.2% to 3.1% more planning time, it improves the widely used planners CEM and MPPI on three released world models, and gains more where planners lose more problems. Without replanning, success rises from 0.39 to 0.76 on Wall with DINO-WM and from 0.56 to 0.94 for MPPI on JEPA-WM. With replanning (MPC), it rises from 0.70 to 0.81 on Cube with LeWM.

AI.title_zh: 规划还是对抗样本？面向潜在世界模型的往返校验
AI.abstract_zh: 如果我们优化一张图像，直到某个分类器确信它显示的是一只猫，我们得到的可能是一个对抗样本，而不是一只猫。用潜在世界模型进行规划，同样是搜索这样一些动作：其预测未来与目标最接近。那么得到的结果是一个规划，还是世界模型的一个对抗样本？我们表明，二者皆有可能。在已发布的 DINO-WM 和 LeWM 上，交叉熵方法（CEM）的迭代次数越多，预测代价越低，但会丢失 CEM 此前已解决的最多一半的问题。模型自身的预测并不能揭示这些失败。我们提出一个简单的检验：在每次迭代后执行该规划，并统计规划器解决后又丢失的问题数量。与图像不同，规划附带其动作，我们的往返校验（round-trip check）用一个小网络从预测状态中读回这些动作，并对不匹配施加惩罚。该校验读回每五个动作组成的块之和，即由两个连续预测状态所确定的部分。在不重新训练世界模型、且仅增加 0.2% 至 3.1% 规划时间的情况下，它在三个已发布的世界模型上改进了广泛使用的规划器 CEM 和 MPPI，并且在规划器丢失问题更多的地方收益更大。在不重新规划的情况下，使用 DINO-WM 时 Wall 上的成功率从 0.39 提升到 0.76，在 JEPA-WM 上 MPPI 的成功率从 0.56 提升到 0.94。在采用重新规划（MPC）的情况下，使用 LeWM 时 Cube 上的成功率从 0.70 提升到 0.81。

title: Writing Weights or Training Them? Spatial Reasoning through Weight-Space Programming and Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Weight-space programming lets a language model inspect and edit another model's weights, offering an alternative to gradient-based adaptation. We evaluated both approaches using Qwen3.5-0.8B on a fixed reference-frame task (128 items), StepGame (200 items), and two untrained distance-comparison tasks. With thinking enabled, the public patch (p50c) raised mean accuracy from 0.0% to 22.1% on the reference-frame task and from 19.2% to 33.7% on StepGame across three sampling seeds. Randomly permuting its weight change removed the gain. Further closed-form edits did not improve on p50c, whereas a rank-1 LoRA adapter trained on worked solutions reached 100% and 98.8%, respectively, with 0.09% trainable parameters. Removing the worked solutions from supervision prevented the adapter from passing the learning gate. The trained adapters reached 82% accuracy on unseen StepGame sentence templates, 42% on held-out difficulty levels 6-10 after training on levels 1-5, and 33-50% on unseen heading-answer combinations. Their target gains coincided with a sharp decline on the distance tasks: accuracy fell from 94% and 92% under p50c to 0-2%, and their outputs applied the StepGame solution template to distance questions. With thinking disabled and reasoning requested in the visible answer, the base model also solved the distance tasks while remaining weak on the target tasks. The comparison reveals a trade-off between improving spatial task performance and preserving neighbouring skills: the public edit restored completion while preserving distance performance, whereas supervised adaptation produced much larger target gains together with interference across tasks.

AI.title_zh: 写入权重还是训练权重？通过权重空间编程与低秩适配实现空间推理
AI.abstract_zh: 权重空间编程（weight-space programming）使语言模型能够检查并编辑另一个模型的权重，为基于梯度的适配提供了一种替代方案。我们在一个固定的参考系任务（128 个条目）、StepGame（200 个条目）以及两个未经训练的距离比较任务上，使用 Qwen3.5-0.8B 对两种方法进行了评估。在启用思考（thinking）的情况下，公开补丁（p50c）在三个采样种子上将参考系任务的平均准确率从 0.0% 提升到 22.1%，将 StepGame 上的平均准确率从 19.2% 提升到 33.7%。随机置换其权重变化后，增益消失。进一步的闭式编辑未能超越 p50c，而在逐步解答（worked solutions）上训练的秩为 1 的 LoRA 适配器分别达到了 100% 和 98.8%，其可训练参数占比为 0.09%。从监督信号中移除逐步解答后，适配器无法通过学习门槛。训练后的适配器在未见过的 StepGame 句子模板上达到 82% 的准确率，在仅于难度等级 1-5 上训练后，在留出的难度等级 6-10 上达到 42% 的准确率，在未见过的朝向—答案组合上达到 33-50% 的准确率。其目标任务上的增益伴随着距离任务上的急剧下降：准确率从 p50c 下的 94% 和 92% 降至 0-2%，且其输出将 StepGame 的解答模板套用于距离问题。在禁用思考且要求在可见答案中进行推理时，基础模型也能解决距离任务，同时在目标任务上仍然表现较弱。该比较揭示了在提升空间任务性能与保持相邻技能之间的一种权衡：公开编辑在保持距离任务性能的同时恢复了任务完成能力，而监督式适配带来了大得多的目标增益，同时也造成了跨任务的干扰。

title: Hindsight Forcing: Learning Better History from the Future in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables real-time streaming generation, with each generated chunk serving as historical context for subsequent generation. To avoid the memory explosion of backpropagation through time, previous self-rollout methods typically truncate cross-chunk gradients or detach historical latents. As a result, earlier denoising computations receive no downstream feedback through the generated history on how to synthesize frames that facilitate subsequent generation, leading to visual drift and structural collapse as rollouts extend. To address this limitation, we propose Hindsight Forcing, which allows historical chunks to learn directly from future outcomes by decoupling forward generation from backward credit assignment via a latent straight-through bridge. In the forward pass, each chunk completes a full multi-step rollout to update the KV cache. In the backward pass, the bridge routes gradients from future losses back to a single selected denoising step per historical chunk, training both the context writer and historical denoiser on shared parameters without retaining the full trajectory graph. Remarkably, Hindsight Forcing requires no additional model parameters, architecture modifications, or separate trajectory replay. Extensive experiments on VBench demonstrate that Hindsight Forcing outperforms existing baselines in overall visual quality and dynamic motion, while ablation studies validate the benefit of supervising historical denoising. Code is available at https://github.com/haonanAN309/Hindsight-Forcing.

AI.title_zh: 后见之明强制：在自回归视频扩散中从未来学习更好的历史
AI.abstract_zh: 少步自回归视频扩散使实时流式生成成为可能，其中每个生成的块都作为后续生成的历史上下文。为避免基于时间的反向传播（backpropagation through time）带来的内存爆炸，以往的自展开（self-rollout）方法通常会截断跨块梯度或分离（detach）历史潜变量。结果是，较早的去噪计算无法通过所生成的历史获得关于如何合成有利于后续生成的帧的下游反馈，导致随着展开延长而出现视觉漂移和结构崩塌。为解决这一局限，我们提出后见之明强制（Hindsight Forcing），它通过一个潜空间直通桥（latent straight-through bridge）将前向生成与反向信用分配解耦，使历史块能够直接从未来结果中学习。在前向传播中，每个块完成完整的多步展开以更新 KV 缓存。在反向传播中，该桥将来自未来损失的梯度回传到每个历史块中单个选定的去噪步，在共享参数上同时训练上下文写入器（context writer）和历史去噪器，而无需保留完整的轨迹计算图。值得注意的是，后见之明强制不需要额外的模型参数、架构修改或单独的轨迹重放。在 VBench 上的大量实验表明，后见之明强制在整体视觉质量和动态运动方面优于现有基线，同时消融研究验证了对历史去噪进行监督的益处。代码见 https://github.com/haonanAN309/Hindsight-Forcing。

title: V2VFusion: Text-Controlled Video-to-Video Diffusion for Degradation-Aware Video Fusion
summary: Video fusion integrates complementary information in multiple source video streams into a single sequence for complete scene perception. Existing methods perform frame-wise fusion and lack unified spatio-temporal modeling across sequences, damaging temporal coherence across sequences. When dealing with degradations, they also ignore temporal dynamics and overload a single network with diverse degradations, leading to limited and imbalanced degradation suppression. To address these issues, we propose V2VFusion, the first unified video-to-video fusion framework that directly generates temporally coherent, high-quality fused videos from degraded multi-source inputs. By reformulating video fusion as a video-to-video conditional generation problem in latent diffusion space, our approach holistically models spatio-temporal dependencies across entire sequences and intrinsically ensures sequence-level consistency. On this basis, a text-guided degradation-conditioned ControlNet bridges high-level textual degradation descriptions with low-level visual priors, enabling interpretable and controllable guidance for structure-preserving fusion beyond purely data-driven conditioning. To handle heterogeneous and compound degradations, a state-modulated degradation-aware hierarchical mixture-of-experts module decouples expert selection into diffusion-state-aware filtering and degradation-aware routing. It prevents unreliable routing and fosters expert specialization to mitigate representation conflicts among diverse degradations. Experiments on infrared-visible, multi-exposure, and multi-focus video fusion tasks and complex degradations validate that V2VFusion surpasses existing methods in fusion quality and temporal stability. The code is available at https://github.com/ChenDoubleJ/V2VFusion.

AI.title_zh: V2VFusion：面向退化感知视频融合的文本控制视频到视频扩散方法
AI.abstract_zh: 视频融合将多个源视频流中的互补信息整合为单一序列，以实现完整的场景感知。现有方法逐帧进行融合，缺乏跨序列的统一时空建模，从而破坏了跨序列的时间一致性。在处理退化时，这些方法还忽略了时间动态，并以单一网络承载多种退化，导致退化抑制效果有限且不均衡。为解决这些问题，我们提出 V2VFusion，这是首个统一的视频到视频融合框架，可直接从退化的多源输入生成时间一致的高质量融合视频。通过将视频融合重新表述为潜空间扩散中的视频到视频条件生成问题，我们的方法在整个序列上整体建模时空依赖关系，并在本质上保证序列级一致性。在此基础上，一个文本引导的、以退化为条件的 ControlNet 将高层文本退化描述与低层视觉先验相连接，从而在纯数据驱动条件之外实现可解释、可控的引导，以支持保持结构的融合。为处理异构且复合的退化，一个状态调制的退化感知分层混合专家模块将专家选择解耦为扩散状态感知过滤与退化感知路由。它可防止不可靠的路由，并促进专家特化，从而缓解不同退化之间的表示冲突。在红外-可见光、多曝光和多聚焦视频融合任务以及复杂退化上的实验验证表明，V2VFusion 在融合质量和时间稳定性方面优于现有方法。代码可在 https://github.com/ChenDoubleJ/V2VFusion 获取。

title: RoboColiseum: Co-evolution of Simulation, Evaluation, and Models
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. The first eight authors contributed equally. Maoqing Yao and Qian Wang are the corresponding authors
summary: Simulation-based evaluation of embodied models requires calibrated interactions, diverse tasks, and explicit execution constraints. We present RoboColiseum, a platform combining system identification, composable physics and rendering, and multidimensional benchmarking. Recorded-command replay characterizes robot dynamics and object interactions, while a shared interface connects rigid and deformable simulation to rendering. Across 22 paired real--simulation robot--task configurations, task scores have a reported Pearson correlation of 0.9686. Eight evaluation tracks span instruction following, spatial reasoning, general manipulation, robustness, dexterous manipulation, precision manipulation, whole-body coordination, and execution across robot embodiments. Budget-aware scoring combines task progress, resource use, and completion rewards. We report 12 selected Season~I policies and all 11 systems on the public Season~II leaderboard, comprising eight Agent systems and three VLA policies. Agent2Act connects language models to robot-control execution; the VLA study uses mixed-task supervised fine-tuning. The results reveal substantial variation across tracks within each evaluation category. RoboColiseum connects simulation development with capability-oriented evaluation and provides a foundation for extending robot interactions and model assessment.

AI.title_zh: RoboColiseum：仿真、评估与模型的协同演化
AI.abstract_zh: 基于仿真的具身模型评估需要经过校准的交互、多样化的任务以及明确的执行约束。我们提出 RoboColiseum，一个结合系统辨识、可组合物理与渲染以及多维基准测试的平台。记录指令回放（recorded-command replay）用于刻画机器人动力学与物体交互，而一个共享接口将刚体与可变形体仿真连接到渲染。在 22 组配对的真实—仿真机器人—任务配置中，任务得分报告的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.9686。八条评估赛道涵盖指令遵循、空间推理、通用操作、鲁棒性、灵巧操作、精密操作、全身协调以及跨机器人本体（embodiments）的执行。预算感知评分（budget-aware scoring）结合任务进展、资源使用与完成奖励。我们报告了入选第一赛季（Season~I）的 12 个策略，以及公开第二赛季（Season~II）排行榜上的全部 11 个系统，其中包括八个 Agent 系统和三个 VLA 策略。Agent2Act 将语言模型连接到机器人控制执行；VLA 研究采用混合任务监督微调。结果揭示了每个评估类别内部各赛道之间存在显著差异。RoboColiseum 将仿真开发与面向能力的评估相连接，并为扩展机器人交互与模型评估提供了基础。

title: Mind World Models: Joint Learning of Motor EEG Representations and Action-Conditioned World Dynamics
summary: Motor decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) supports non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, yet existing methods either rely on costly cue-based trials and coarse categorical labels or use pretraining objectives that do not directly capture how movement unfolds, limiting their ability to learn transferable motor representations. To this end, we propose the Mind World Model (MWM), a framework that learns motor EEG representations from scalable naturalistic EEG and egocentric video without action annotations. MWM treats EEG observed up to the current frame as the latent action of a world model: a mind model encodes the EEG, and a world model uses it to predict the representation of a future frame, yielding a movement-grounded pretraining objective. We further introduce the Lateralization-Aware Transformer (LAT), which uses frame averaging to separate shared bilateral from side-specific lateral features, encoding hemispheric correspondence to reduce the burden of learning left-right relationships from data. MWM pretraining produces two models: a mind model for downstream motor decoding and a world model that can be adapted to prediction conditioned on real actions, opening a scalable and flexible path to collect egocentric data for embodied AI. Across 9 classification and 7 regression tasks, the mind model improves task-averaged balanced accuracy by 5.9% and Pearson correlation by 16.2% relative to the strongest baseline in each task family. Compared with an inverse-dynamics latent-action baseline, the world model achieves lower prediction error and benefits 3.3 times more from matched real actions within recordings and 4.7 times more on held-out subjects.

AI.title_zh: 心智世界模型：运动脑电表征与动作条件世界动态的联合学习
AI.abstract_zh: 基于脑电图（EEG）的运动解码支持非侵入式脑机接口，然而现有方法要么依赖成本高昂的基于提示的试次与粗粒度的类别标签，要么使用并未直接刻画运动如何展开的预训练目标，从而限制了其学习可迁移运动表征的能力。为此，我们提出心智世界模型（Mind World Model, MWM），这是一个无需动作标注、从可扩展的自然情境脑电与自我中心视频中学习运动脑电表征的框架。MWM 将截至当前帧所观测到的脑电视为世界模型的潜在动作：心智模型（mind model）对脑电进行编码，世界模型利用该编码预测未来帧的表征，从而得到一个以运动为根基的预训练目标。我们进一步引入侧化感知 Transformer（Lateralization-Aware Transformer, LAT），它利用帧平均将共享的双侧特征与侧别特异的侧化特征分离，编码半球间对应关系，以减轻从数据中学习左右关系的负担。MWM 预训练产生两个模型：一个用于下游运动解码的心智模型，以及一个可被适配为以真实动作为条件进行预测的世界模型，为面向具身智能采集自我中心数据开辟了一条可扩展且灵活的路径。在 9 个分类任务和 7 个回归任务上，相对于各任务族中最强的基线，心智模型将任务平均平衡准确率提升了 5.9%，将 Pearson 相关系数提升了 16.2%。与逆动力学潜在动作基线相比，世界模型取得更低的预测误差，并且在记录内从匹配的真实动作中获益多 3.3 倍，在留出受试者上获益多 4.7 倍。

title: ReactDrive: Self-Reactive Driving World Model
summary: The world evolves through the dynamics of its constituent entities and their interactions, with changes in one entity influencing the behavior of others. To simulate this evolution under different actions, interactive world models need to capture the resulting agent responses as part of the world's own dynamics. In autonomous driving, errors in modeling these responses can misrepresent maneuver safety and undermine the reliability of generated videos used for policy evaluation and learning. To formalize this intrinsic requirement for driving world model, we define self-reactivity as the capability to model agent responses from observed history and a specified ego action, and generate visual futures that reflect those responses without prescribed future agent trajectories. To realize this capability, we introduce ReactDrive, a driving world model that jointly learns agent dynamics and visual generation through a shared agent state representation. Within this framework, dynamics supervision grounds a reactive dynamics prior in observed agent states, while the video objective jointly optimizes the self-reactivity and visual realism. Experiments show improved agent responses, ego controllability, and video quality, a 96.0% preference for agent reactivity in human comparisons across five baselines, and better downstream planning through augmentation with generated videos. We hope this work encourages the community to recognize self-reactivityas a foundational capability for developing and evaluating interactive world models. Project page: https://reactdrive.github.io/ .

AI.title_zh: ReactDrive：自反应式驾驶世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界通过其组成实体的动力学及其相互作用而演化，其中一个实体的变化会影响其他实体的行为。为了在不同动作下模拟这种演化，交互式世界模型需要将由此产生的智能体响应作为世界自身动力学的一部分加以捕捉。在自动驾驶中，对这些响应建模的误差会错误地反映机动的安全性，并损害用于策略评估与学习的生成视频的可靠性。为了形式化驾驶世界模型的这一内在要求，我们将自反应性（self-reactivity）定义为：从观测到的历史和指定的自车动作出发对智能体响应进行建模，并在不预先指定未来智能体轨迹的情况下生成反映这些响应的视觉未来。为实现这一能力，我们提出 ReactDrive，一种通过共享智能体状态表示联合学习智能体动力学与视觉生成的驾驶世界模型。在该框架中，动力学监督将反应式动力学先验建立在观测到的智能体状态之上，而视频目标则联合优化自反应性与视觉真实感。实验表明，智能体响应、自车可控性和视频质量均有所改善，在针对五个基线的真人对比中，智能体反应性获得了 96.0% 的偏好率，并且通过生成视频进行增强可带来更好的下游规划。我们希望这项工作能促使社区认识到自反应性是开发与评估交互式世界模型的一项基础能力。项目页面：https://reactdrive.github.io/ 。

title: SceneRuler: Measuring Physical Quantities in Video via Minimal Sufficient Reconstruction
summary: Many questions about videos ask for a number, such as how tall a person is, how far a cart travels, or how fast a ball leaves a ramp. We study this task, quantitative physical reasoning from video, where the inputs are a video, a question, and a prior of known facts such as object sizes, speeds, and distances from the camera to named objects. End-to-end video-language models lack an explicit metric scale and physical consistency, and their errors cannot be inspected. We present SceneRuler, which instead recovers a measurable physical scene and answers with that scene as evidence. Its central principle, Minimal Sufficient Reconstruction, builds, for each question, only the smallest scene that suffices to measure the asked quantity, and tests sufficiency on measurements rather than assuming it. The scene is written as a program whose structure a vision-language model writes and whose magnitudes are left to measurement. Physics-guided Fitting measures them through physical motion laws, so that gravity itself can anchor the metric scale, and marks every parameter, and the read-out of the asked quantity, as determined or undetermined. Each question receives a read-out and an answer. The read-out is the asked quantity evaluated on the scene, and it is empty when the scene does not fix that quantity. The answer is always given by a model that takes the scene as evidence. We evaluate on QuantiPhy and also apply the method to 27 in-the-wild videos that we collected, which have no ground-truth answers. On its validation split, the final answer reaches a mean relative accuracy of 0.709 against 0.624 for the strongest baseline, and the reconstruction determines the asked quantity on 47 of 158 questions, where the final answer reaches 0.781. Because every intermediate quantity is explicit, each answer can be traced to the objects, scale, and motion behind it.

AI.title_zh: SceneRuler：通过最小充分重建测量视频中的物理量
AI.abstract_zh: 许多关于视频的问题都要求给出一个数值，例如一个人有多高、一辆小车行驶了多远，或者一个球离开斜面时的速度有多快。我们研究这一任务，即从视频中进行定量物理推理，其输入为一段视频、一个问题，以及由已知事实构成的先验，例如物体尺寸、速度以及相机到指定物体的距离。端到端的视频-语言模型缺乏显式的度量尺度与物理一致性，且其错误无法被检查。我们提出 SceneRuler，它转而恢复一个可测量的物理场景，并以该场景作为证据来回答问题。其核心原则——最小充分重建（Minimal Sufficient Reconstruction）——针对每个问题只构建足以测量所问量的最小场景，并在测量结果上检验其充分性，而非假定其充分。场景被写成一个程序，其结构由视觉-语言模型编写，而其量值则留给测量。物理引导拟合（Physics-guided Fitting）通过物理运动定律测量这些量值，从而使重力本身能够锚定度量尺度，并将每个参数以及所问量的读出标记为已确定或未确定。每个问题都得到一个读出和一个答案。读出是在场景上对所问量的求值，当场景未确定该量时读出为空。答案始终由一个将该场景作为证据的模型给出。我们在 QuantiPhy 上进行评估，并将该方法应用于我们收集的 27 段真实场景（in-the-wild）视频，这些视频没有真值答案。在其验证划分上，最终答案达到 0.709 的平均相对准确率，而最强基线为 0.624；重建在 158 个问题中的 47 个问题上确定了所问量，在这些问题上最终答案达到 0.781。由于每个中间量都是显式的，每个答案都可以追溯到其背后的物体、尺度和运动。

title: ViewDreamer: A Robot World Model beyond Fixed Camera Setups
summary: Video generation models are increasingly important for robot learning, yet most generate each camera view separately or tile all views in a fixed layout. Robot demonstrations, however, are captured by synchronized cameras whose number, placement, and order vary across embodiments. We present ViewDreamer, a single world model that handles variable sets of cameras by disentangling per-view generation from cross-view interaction. Each view follows the generation path of a pretrained single-view model, and views interact only through shared slot tokens. We stabilize multi-view training with a curriculum that gradually increases the number of views. Cross-View Slot Agreement uses visual foundation models to group geometrically and semantically similar regions across views into shared slots. On RoboView-Bench, which covers one to four cameras, ViewDreamer achieves the best generation quality among the models evaluated and improves cross-view consistency over independent per-view generation. These gains carry over to our world-action model (WAM) and action-conditioned world model (AC-WM). Our WAM outperforms the FastWAM-Joint baseline on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboDojo, and on a real Franka robot. Both variants improve out-of-domain generalization to various camera settings and scenes.

AI.title_zh: ViewDreamer：一种超越固定相机配置的机器人世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型对机器人学习日益重要，但大多数模型要么分别生成每个相机视角，要么以固定布局拼接所有视角。然而，机器人演示数据是由同步相机采集的，这些相机的数量、位置和顺序因不同具身（embodiment）而异。我们提出 ViewDreamer，这是一个单一的世界模型，通过将逐视角生成与跨视角交互解耦，来处理可变的相机集合。每个视角遵循预训练单视角模型的生成路径，视角之间仅通过共享槽 token（shared slot tokens）进行交互。我们采用逐步增加视角数量的课程学习（curriculum）来稳定多视角训练。跨视角槽对齐（Cross-View Slot Agreement）利用视觉基础模型，将不同视角间在几何和语义上相似的区域分组为共享槽。在覆盖一至四个相机的 RoboView-Bench 上，ViewDreamer 在所评估的模型中取得了最佳生成质量，并且相较于独立的逐视角生成提升了跨视角一致性。这些收益也延续到我们的世界-动作模型（WAM）和动作条件世界模型（AC-WM）中。我们的 WAM 在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 和 RoboDojo 上，以及在真实 Franka 机器人上，均优于 FastWAM-Joint 基线。两种变体都改善了对各种相机设置和场景的域外（out-of-domain）泛化能力。

title: Causal Diffusion for Extreme Super-Resolution in Interactive Games
summary: Existing game super-resolution methods typically operate at moderate upscaling factors, struggling to recover fine visual details from extremely low-resolution inputs (e.g., 120p).
