At such resolutions, super-resolution shifts from reconstructing existing information toward synthesizing missing visual details. While video diffusion models offer powerful generative priors for this challenging task, their dependence on future frames limits their applicability to interactive games. We present CIDER, a causal diffusion framework for extreme game super-resolution that synthesizes high-frequency details from current and past low-resolution frames, guided by G-buffers (depth and motion vectors) to preserve scene structure and temporal consistency. We collect data from two AAA games (Cyberpunk 2077 and Black Myth: Wukong). To reduce inference load, we develop a lightweight latent projection encoder tailored to ultra-low-resolution inputs, fine-tune a decoder (TAE) on our high-resolution outputs, and distill the diffusion model to reach interactive frame rates. Our experiments demonstrate high-fidelity 8$\times$ upscaling from 120p to 960p at around 13 FPS, outperforming state-of-the-art game upscalers in visual quality and showing potential for 16$\times$ magnification.

AI.title_zh: 面向交互式游戏极端超分辨率的因果扩散
AI.abstract_zh: 现有的游戏超分辨率方法通常在中等放大倍数下运行，难以从极低分辨率输入（例如 120p）中恢复精细的视觉细节。在此类分辨率下，超分辨率已从重建已有信息转向合成缺失的视觉细节。尽管视频扩散模型为这一具有挑战性的任务提供了强大的生成先验，但其对未来帧的依赖限制了其在交互式游戏中的适用性。我们提出 CIDER，一个用于极端游戏超分辨率的因果扩散框架，它从当前和过去的低分辨率帧中合成高频细节，并以 G-buffer（深度与运动向量）为引导，以保持场景结构和时间一致性。我们从两款 AAA 游戏（Cyberpunk 2077 和 Black Myth: Wukong）中采集数据。为降低推理负载，我们开发了一个针对超低分辨率输入的轻量级潜空间投影编码器，在我们的高分辨率输出上微调解码器（TAE），并对扩散模型进行蒸馏以达到交互式帧率。我们的实验表明，能够以约 13 FPS 从 120p 到 960p 实现高保真 8$\times$ 放大，在视觉质量上优于最先进的游戏超分辨率方法，并显示出 16$\times$ 放大的潜力。

title: Looking Right Is Not Being Right: Evaluating the Geometry of Agent-Built 3D Scenes
summary: Vision-language agents can reconstruct rooms from video as editable 3D scenes, but convincing renders do not establish geometric accuracy. We introduce a scan-referenced evaluation and use controlled experiments to study reconstruction accuracy, the role of geometric inputs, and agents' ability to verify and correct their scenes. Our geometric score measures surface, depth, and furniture placement agreement with laser scans of 30 real rooms on a 0-100 scale. The strongest tested agent, GPT-6 Astra, scores 51.4 from video alone, while a dense reconstruction from the same video scores 75.9. Given the point cloud used for that reconstruction, Astra produces an editable scene that scores within three points of it. Agents also inherit input errors: rescaling the supplied geometry changes scene scale almost proportionally. During revision, viewing renders improves appearance more consistently than geometry. Logs of their tool calls show that agents repeatedly measure their inputs but rarely compare them with the scenes they build. To provide this missing check, we introduce a geometric error report that compares each saved scene with the agent's input points and lists the largest discrepancies. Without new geometric evidence, the report raises the revision gains of GPT-6.1 Terra and Sol by 3.9 and 5.5 points over concurrent controls.

AI.title_zh: 看起来正确不等于实际正确：评估智能体构建的 3D 场景的几何精度
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言智能体能够从视频中重建房间，生成可编辑的 3D 场景，但渲染效果令人信服并不意味着几何精度达标。我们引入了一种以扫描为参照的评估方法，并通过受控实验研究重建精度、几何输入的作用，以及智能体验证并修正其场景的能力。我们的几何得分以 0-100 的尺度衡量表面、深度和家具布局与 30 个真实房间的激光扫描之间的一致性。所测试的最强智能体 GPT-6 Astra 仅凭视频得到 51.4 分，而对同一视频进行稠密重建则得到 75.9 分。在给定用于该重建的点云时，Astra 生成的可编辑场景得分与该重建相差不超过三分。智能体还会继承输入误差：对所提供的几何进行重新缩放，会使场景尺度几乎成比例地改变。在修订过程中，查看渲染图对表观的改善比对几何的改善更为稳定。它们的工具调用日志显示，智能体反复测量其输入，却很少将输入与其构建的场景进行比较。为提供这一缺失的检查，我们引入了一种几何误差报告，它将每个已保存的场景与智能体的输入点进行比较，并列出最大的差异。在没有新的几何证据的情况下，该报告使 GPT-6.1 Terra 和 Sol 的修订增益相较同期对照组分别提高了 3.9 分和 5.5 分。

title: TouchBench: Can Vision-Language Models Feel Invisible Physical Properties?
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for embodied perception and reasoning, yet their physical understanding is largely evaluated on questions answerable from images. Many properties critical to manipulation, such as an opaque bottle's fill level or an object's compliance, may only be revealed through touch. We introduce TouchBench, an egocentric vision-language-tactile benchmark that distinguishes visually answerable questions (Tier A) from those involving properties hidden from the camera (Tier B). It pairs head-mounted video with synchronized 137-channel whole-hand tactile sensing, comprising 900 clips from five participants across 11 tasks, with 900 absolute and 4,102 relative questions. Four state-of-the-art VLMs average 66.4% accuracy on Tier A relative questions but only 49.8% on Tier B, near chance (50%). To bridge this gap, we propose Tactile-as-Prompt (TaP), which presents 34 interpretable tactile statistics as text, enabling VLMs to reason with touch without a learned tactile encoder. TaP raises zero-shot Tier B relative accuracy to 62.9% and reaches 73.1% after leave-one-user-out fine-tuning, outperforming video alone (67.4%) and a learned tactile-token encoder (67.3%). The gains extend to unseen objects and users. On a separate 20-hour in-the-wild corpus, tactile text improves fine-tuned contact-question accuracy from 67.1% to 75.5%. These results highlight the limits of vision-only physical reasoning and establish language as an effective interface for tactile perception.

AI.title_zh: TouchBench：视觉-语言模型能感受到不可见的物理属性吗？
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）正越来越多地被用于具身感知与推理，然而它们的物理理解能力主要是在可由图像回答的问题上进行评估的。许多对操作至关重要的属性，例如不透明瓶子的液面高度或物体的柔顺性，可能只能通过触摸才能得知。我们提出了 TouchBench，一个以自我为中心的视觉-语言-触觉基准，它将视觉上可回答的问题（Tier A）与涉及被相机遮挡的隐藏属性的问题（Tier B）区分开来。该基准将头戴式视频与同步的 137 通道全手触觉传感配对，包含来自五名参与者、跨越 11 项任务的 900 个片段，以及 900 个绝对问题和 4,102 个相对问题。四个最先进的 VLM 在 Tier A 相对问题上的平均准确率为 66.4%，但在 Tier B 上仅为 49.8%，接近随机水平（50%）。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 Tactile-as-Prompt（TaP），它将 34 个可解释的触觉统计量以文本形式呈现，使 VLM 无需学习到的触觉编码器即可利用触摸进行推理。TaP 将零样本 Tier B 相对准确率提升至 62.9%，在留一用户微调（leave-one-user-out fine-tuning）后达到 73.1%，优于仅使用视频（67.4%）以及学习到的触觉 token 编码器（67.3%）。这些增益可扩展到未见过的物体和用户。在一个单独的 20 小时野外（in-the-wild）语料库上，触觉文本将微调后的接触问题准确率从 67.1% 提升至 75.5%。这些结果凸显了仅依赖视觉的物理推理的局限性，并确立了语言作为触觉感知有效接口的地位。

title: SonoAtlasWorld: Anatomy-Grounded Ultrasound World Models for Wide-Range Scanning
comment: Interactive video demonstrations are available at: https://sonoatlasworld.github.io/SonoAtlasWorld
summary: Learning robotic ultrasound policies requires interactive environments for scalable data generation and repeatable evaluation, while exploration on real patients is limited by acquisition costs and safety constraints. Generative world models offer an alternative, but image history and probe actions alone do not ensure anatomical consistency across wide-range scans and changing acoustic windows. We introduce SonoAtlasWorld, an ultrasound world model built on anatomy as state. A persistent 3D anatomical asset extracted from computed tomography (CT) anchors each scan to a specific anatomy. Probe actions determine anatomical and acoustic visibility conditions for a causal ultrasound generator trained on clinical videos. Our three-stage pipeline combines anatomy-conditioned pretraining, causal conversion and long-rollout alignment. Inference optimizations achieve pose-to-ultrasound throughput of 81.2 FPS. To evaluate anatomical control beyond image similarity, we introduce the Action-Following Index (AFI), which measures normalized reconstruction gain over a static-prefix baseline. On 40 held-out 3D volumes, SonoAtlasWorld achieves liver and macro-organ AFI of 0.428 and 0.262, compared with at most 0.117 and 0.038 for the tested action- and geometry-conditioned methods. Long-rollout alignment reduces brightness drift by 3.46x at the end of 40 repeated scan cycles. SonoAtlasWorld also generates offline policy-training demonstrations and supports anatomically grounded closed-loop evaluation. Scaling the generated training data improves key-plane acquisition success from 48.2% to 81.2% on unseen anatomies in simulation, demonstrating its utility for robotic ultrasound policy learning.

AI.title_zh: SonoAtlasWorld：面向广域扫描的解剖学锚定超声世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 学习机器人超声策略需要交互式环境，以支持可扩展的数据生成和可重复的评估，而在真实患者身上的探索受限于采集成本和安全约束。生成式世界模型提供了一种替代方案，但仅凭图像历史和探头动作无法确保在广域扫描和变化的声窗下保持解剖学一致性。我们提出 SonoAtlasWorld，一种以解剖结构为状态的超声世界模型。从计算机断层扫描（CT）中提取的持久性三维解剖资产将每次扫描锚定到特定的解剖结构。探头动作决定解剖可见性与声学可见性条件，供在临床视频上训练的因果超声生成器使用。我们的三阶段流程结合了解剖条件预训练、因果转换和长时程推演对齐。推理优化实现了 81.2 FPS 的位姿到超声吞吐量。为了在图像相似度之外评估解剖学控制能力，我们引入了动作跟随指数（Action-Following Index, AFI），该指标衡量相对于静态前缀基线的归一化重建增益。在 40 个体外三维体数据上，SonoAtlasWorld 达到的肝脏 AFI 和宏器官（macro-organ）AFI 分别为 0.428 和 0.262，而所测试的动作条件方法与几何条件方法分别至多为 0.117 和 0.038。长时程推演对齐在 40 次重复扫描周期结束时将亮度漂移降低了 3.46 倍。SonoAtlasWorld 还能生成离线策略训练演示，并支持解剖学锚定的闭环评估。扩大生成的训练数据规模后，在仿真中对未见解剖结构的关键平面采集成功率从 48.2% 提升至 81.2%，证明了其对机器人超声策略学习的实用性。

title: FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies
summary: Imitation learning for surgical robots is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. Meanwhile, many robot-assisted procedures are recorded as stereo video, yet policies cannot learn from them directly; clinical video carries no action labels. We present FlowScope, which pretrains a surgical policy network on unlabeled clinical video by forecasting scene flow, the metric 3D motion of scene points, with labels computed by off-the-shelf stereo depth and optical flow models. We pretrain the trunk of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) on a dataset of 1,149 clinical procedures (1.35M clips) and discard the flow head afterward, so the deployed policy is a standard ACT with no added inference cost. On a real surgical robotic system, FlowScope raises needle pickup success from 54% to 90% and first-handover success on needle regrasp from 4% to 52% (full task: 2% to 14%) over training from scratch (n=50 trials each), and retains its gains with a generative flow-matching action head. Ablations indicate that metric 3D motion is the strongest pretraining signal among those tested; kinematics, 2D tracks, depth alone, and scale-free 3D flow, each paired with kinematics, yield smaller or no gains. Representation analyses suggest that scene-flow pretraining encodes metric needle depth more accurately, that kinematics pretraining increases reliance on the robot state, and that needle-depth probes follow the ordering of real-robot success where offline validation error does not.

AI.title_zh: FlowScope：三维场景流预训练提升手术机器人策略
AI.abstract_zh: 手术机器人的模仿学习受限于采集示教数据的成本。与此同时，许多机器人辅助手术被记录为立体视频，但策略无法直接从这些视频中学习；临床视频不携带动作标签。我们提出 FlowScope，它通过在无标签临床视频上预测场景流（scene flow，即场景点的度量三维运动）来预训练手术策略网络，其标签由现成的立体深度与光流模型计算得到。我们在包含 1,149 台临床手术（135 万段视频片段）的数据集上预训练 Action Chunking Transformer（ACT）的主干，随后丢弃流预测头，因此部署的策略就是标准 ACT，不增加任何推理开销。在真实手术机器人系统上，与从零训练相比（每组 n=50 次试验），FlowScope 将拾针成功率从 54% 提升至 90%，将针再抓取任务中的首次交接成功率从 4% 提升至 52%（完整任务：从 2% 提升至 14%），并且在使用生成式流匹配动作头时仍保持其增益。消融实验表明，在所测试的各类信号中，度量三维运动是最强的预训练信号；运动学、二维轨迹、仅深度以及无尺度三维流各自与运动学配对时，带来的增益更小或没有增益。表征分析表明，场景流预训练能更准确地编码度量意义上的针深度，运动学预训练会增加对机器人状态的依赖，并且针深度探针的结果与真实机器人成功率的排序一致，而离线验证误差则不一致。

title: Skill-JEPA: Learning Planner-Aligned Action Spaces for World Models
summary: World models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn from pixels to predict the outcome of actions in a latent space. To reach a goal, a planner samples many candidate action sequences, uses the model to predict where each one leads, and executes the best one. However, standard planners draw their candidates from a Gaussian, while the model has only seen the structured, state-dependent actions of its training data. Its predictions for such candidates are unreliable, and planning fails more often as goals move farther away. We propose Skill-JEPA, which learns an action space aligned with the planner. A variational autoencoder conditioned on the current state encodes short action sequences into latent skills with a standard Gaussian prior, and decodes them back into actions. The world model predicts the effect of skills rather than raw actions, and the planner searches over skills starting from that same Gaussian, so its candidates resemble the model's training data. Skill-JEPA adds a single module, trained end-to-end with the world model, and leaves the planner untouched, with no subgoals, hierarchy, or hand-designed skills. Across three JEPA world models and four benchmarks, average success on goals 80 steps away rises from 42% with raw actions to 62%; the gains grow with goal distance and hold across four planners. On AntMaze, a quadruped locomotion task, success on goals two maze cells away rises from 0.4% to 38%. This suggests that part of the difficulty of reaching distant goals lies in the action space, and can be removed without changing the planner.

AI.title_zh: Skill-JEPA：为世界模型学习与规划器对齐的动作空间
AI.abstract_zh: 基于联合嵌入预测架构（Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures, JEPAs）的世界模型从像素中学习，在潜在空间中预测动作的结果。为了达成目标，规划器采样大量候选动作序列，利用模型预测每个候选序列会导向何处，并执行其中最优的一个。然而，标准规划器从高斯分布中抽取候选，而模型只见过其训练数据中结构化的、依赖状态的动作。模型对此类候选的预测不可靠，并且随着目标变得更为遥远，规划失败的频率也随之增加。我们提出 Skill-JEPA，它学习一个与规划器对齐的动作空间。一个以当前状态为条件的变分自编码器将短动作序列编码为具有标准高斯先验的潜在技能，并将它们解码回动作。世界模型预测技能的效果而非原始动作的效果，规划器则从同一高斯分布出发在技能空间中进行搜索，因此其候选与模型的训练数据相似。Skill-JEPA 仅增加一个模块，与世界模型进行端到端训练，并且不改动规划器，无需子目标、分层结构或手工设计的技能。在三个 JEPA 世界模型和四个基准上，距离 80 步的目标的平均成功率从使用原始动作时的 42% 上升到 62%；增益随目标距离增大而增长，并在四个规划器上均成立。在四足运动任务 AntMaze 上，相隔两个迷宫单元格的目标的成功率从 0.4% 上升到 38%。这表明，达成遥远目标的部分困难在于动作空间，并且可以在不改变规划器的情况下将其消除。

title: Spatial Query Execution as Verifiable Rewards for Multi-step Spatial Reasoning
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) remain unreliable on spatial reasoning problems that require composing grounded relations across multiple objects. Yet, scaling reasoning supervision is challenging since human-annotated visual datasets often rely on fixed relational annotations and coarse object localization, making it difficult to obtain precise intermediate reasoning states across diverse spatial configurations and complexities. We introduce FARON (Fully Automated Reasoning Over spatial relatioNs), a framework that executes spatial queries to provide both execution-grounded reasoning supervision and verifiable outcome rewards. Rather than relying on existing annotated data, FARON constructs synthetic 2D and 3D scenes with explicit geometries, enabling configurable object arrangements, spatial relations, and multi-step compositions. Deterministic query execution yields intermediate sets and final answers, providing precise supervision without manual relation annotation. Our pipeline converts intermediate states into natural-language reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while the execution-derived answers provide verifiable rewards for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Controlled experiments show that trace-based SFT improves multi-step spatial reasoning over final-answer supervision and that subsequent group relative policy optimization (GRPO) provides further gains. The resulting models also demonstrate transfer across external spatial reasoning benchmarks and multiple LVLM backbones without benchmark-specific fine-tuning. These results show the potential of using spatial query execution as a unified, flexible source of reasoning supervision and verifiable outcome rewards for multimodal spatial reasoning.

AI.title_zh: 空间查询执行作为多步空间推理的可验证奖励
AI.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在需要跨多个对象组合接地关系（grounded relations）的空间推理问题上仍然不可靠。然而，扩展推理监督具有挑战性，因为人工标注的视觉数据集往往依赖固定的关系标注和粗粒度的对象定位，这使得在多样的空间配置与复杂度下难以获得精确的中间推理状态。我们提出了 FARON（Fully Automated Reasoning Over spatial relatioNs，全自动空间关系推理），这是一个执行空间查询以同时提供基于执行的推理监督和可验证结果奖励的框架。FARON 不依赖现有标注数据，而是构建具有显式几何结构的合成 2D 和 3D 场景，从而支持可配置的对象排布、空间关系和多步组合。确定性的查询执行产生中间集合和最终答案，无需人工关系标注即可提供精确监督。我们的流水线将中间状态转换为自然语言的推理轨迹，用于监督微调（SFT），而由执行得到的答案则为带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提供可验证奖励。受控实验表明，基于轨迹的 SFT 相比最终答案监督能改善多步空间推理，并且随后的组相对策略优化（GRPO）带来了进一步提升。所得模型还在无需针对特定基准进行微调的情况下，在外部空间推理基准和多个 LVLM 主干模型上展现出迁移能力。这些结果表明，将空间查询执行用作多模态空间推理的统一、灵活的推理监督与可验证结果奖励来源具有潜力。

title: Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures. Includes supplementary material (Sections S-I through S-X)
summary: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. We prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability, an ablation localizes each to the referee and world model rather than the policy, and two independent LLM judges reproduce the rubric's engine ranking. Our central result is cautionary, and we prove it: a validator reading any graph feature set a structure-matched random graph can reproduce is uninformative about coherence for a coherence-by-construction generator. Using Erdős-Rényi controls we realize the theorem four times, as structural separation, embedding transfer, inductive link prediction, and real-data augmentation each reward a triviality rather than coherence; we give the mechanism behind each and the conditions a valid benchmark must meet.

AI.title_zh: 构造即连贯：合成CTI知识图谱与连贯性验证的形式化极限
AI.abstract_zh: 合成知识图谱这类关系型训练数据时，使用大语言模型通常一次只输出一个结构化对象，这使每个对象本身保持有效，但对象之间的关系却缺乏根基。我们研究一种替代范式——通过模拟进行生成：我们不描述一个关系型人工制品，而是模拟产生它的过程，并将该人工制品视为其因果记录。语言模型智能体提出意图，确定性裁判依据显式的世界模型裁决结果，因此只有当某个关系所表示的事件实际发生时，该关系才会被输出，从而使连贯性成为构造的一种属性。我们以STIX 2.1标准将该范式实例化于网络威胁情报知识图谱，采用三个引擎，其中包括一个对结构化图基因组施加语言模型遗传算子的演化引擎，它们共享一个确定性编译器，使格式错误与悬空的输出无法被表示。我们证明了引用闭包性、因果扎根性与标识符稳定性，通过消融实验将这三者定位到裁判与世界模型而非策略，并且两个独立的LLM评判者复现了评分细则给出的引擎排序。我们的核心结果是警示性的，并且我们对其加以证明：对于构造即连贯的生成器而言，任何读取可由结构匹配的随机图复现的图特征的验证器，在连贯性方面都是无信息量的。借助Erdős-Rényi对照，我们四次实现该定理，分别作为结构分离、嵌入迁移、归纳式链接预测和真实数据增强，每一次奖励的都是某种平凡性而非连贯性；我们给出每一种情形背后的机制，以及一个有效基准必须满足的条件。

title: Latent Space Planning with Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: Planning with learned world models amounts to finding action sequences whose predicted rollouts reach a goal. Sampling-based planners often struggle at longer horizons, while gradient-based methods can become trapped in local minima. Meanwhile, model predictive path integral control (MPPI), a complementary approach, alternates between estimating an expectation under a cost-weighted distribution from samples and updating the plan from this estimate. Its samples, however, are drawn afresh at every iteration from a Gaussian proposal and reach the target distribution only through importance weights. Moreover, a target distribution favoring goal-reaching trajectories can be difficult to define directly, motivating a sequence of intermediate distributions. Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) provides a natural mechanism for evolving such a sequence through importance weighting and resampling. Motivated by this, we formulate latent-space planning as optimization guided by SMC, which moves a population of action sequences while a gradient-based optimizer updates the plan. Inspired by classical planning, we further introduce a PDE-derived cost-to-go that guides the evolution of the sample distribution using the structure of the latent state space. On navigation and manipulation tasks with visual and proprioceptive world models, our formulation outperforms gradient-based planners by $29$ and $50$, sampling-based planners by $35$ and MPPI by $7$ percentage points in average success rate, while succeeding in fewer iterations than gradient-based planners and within 4\% of MPPI.

AI.title_zh: 基于序贯蒙特卡洛的潜空间规划
AI.abstract_zh: 使用学习到的世界模型进行规划，本质上是要找到其预测推演能够到达目标的动作序列。基于采样的规划器往往在较长的时间跨度上表现不佳，而基于梯度的方法则可能陷入局部极小值。与此同时，模型预测路径积分控制（MPPI）作为一种互补方法，在根据样本估计代价加权分布下的期望与依据该估计更新规划之间交替进行。然而，它的样本在每次迭代时都从高斯提议分布中重新抽取，并且只能通过重要性权重到达目标分布。此外，倾向于到达目标的轨迹的目标分布可能难以直接定义，这促使人们引入一系列中间分布。序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）提供了一种自然机制，通过重要性加权与重采样来演化这样的分布序列。受此启发，我们将潜空间规划表述为以 SMC 为指导的优化，它移动一个动作序列种群，同时由基于梯度的优化器更新规划。受经典规划的启发，我们进一步引入一个由 PDE 导出的代价到达值（cost-to-go），它利用潜状态空间的结构来引导样本分布的演化。在具有视觉和本体感知世界模型的导航与操作任务上，我们的表述在平均成功率上分别比基于梯度的规划器高出 $29$ 和 $50$ 个百分点、比基于采样的规划器高出 $35$ 个百分点、比 MPPI 高出 $7$ 个百分点，同时所需迭代次数少于基于梯度的规划器，并且与 MPPI 的差距在 4\% 以内。
